cheeseburger.name: Cheeseburger
cheeseburger.about: A grilled beef patty with melted cheese in a soft bun.
steps: Ground beef is shaped into a patty and seasoned with salt and pepper.
It is cooked on a very hot griddle or grill, and cheese is laid on top in the last minute to melt.
The patty goes into a toasted bun with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles and sauce.
cheeseburger.tip: You'll usually be asked how you want it cooked. "Medium" is pink in the middle; "well done" is cooked through.

wiki_summary.extract: A cheeseburger is a hamburger with melted cheese on top of the meat patty, added near the end of the cooking time. Cheeseburgers can include variations in structure, ingredients and composition. As with other hamburgers, a cheeseburger may include various condiments and other toppings such as lettuce, tomato and ketchup.

french-fries.name: French fries
french-fries.about: Strips of potato fried until crisp outside and soft inside.
steps: Potatoes are cut into strips and often soaked to remove starch.
They are fried twice, first at a lower heat to cook through, then hotter to crisp.
They are salted straight out of the oil.
french-fries.tip: Some places fry in beef fat; ask if you need them vegetarian.

wiki_summary.extract: French fries, or simply fries, also known as French fried potatoes, chips, and finger chips, are batonnet or julienne-cut deep-fried potatoes of disputed origin. They are prepared by cutting potatoes into even strips, drying them, and frying them, usually in a deep fryer. Pre-cut, blanched, and frozen russet potatoes are widely used, and sometimes baked in a regular or convection oven, such as an air fryer.

milkshake.name: Milkshake
milkshake.about: A thick cold drink of ice cream blended with milk.
steps: Ice cream and milk are blended until thick and smooth.
Syrup, fruit or cookies are blended in for flavour.
It is served in a tall glass, often topped with whipped cream.

wiki_summary.extract: A milkshake is a sweet beverage made by blending milk, ice cream, and flavorings or sweeteners such as butterscotch, caramel sauce, chocolate syrup, or fruit syrup into a thick, sweet, cold mixture. It may also be made using a base made from non-dairy products, including plant milks such as almond milk, coconut milk, or soy milk. Dry ingredients such as whole fruit, nuts, seeds, candy, or cookies are sometimes incorporated.

hot-dog.name: Hot dog
hot-dog.about: A grilled or boiled sausage in a long soft bun.
steps: The frankfurter is boiled, steamed or grilled.
It is placed in a split bun.
It is topped with mustard and other toppings. In New York, mustard and sauerkraut or onions are classic.
hot-dog.tip: Most New York street hot dogs are all-beef; ask if you avoid pork.

wiki_summary.extract: A hot dog is a grilled, steamed, or boiled sausage served in the slit of a partially sliced bun. The term hot dog can also refer to the sausage itself. The sausage used is a wiener or a frankfurter. The names of these sausages commonly refer to their assembled dish. Hot dog preparation and condiments vary worldwide. Common condiments include mustard, ketchup, relish, onions in tomato sauce, and cheese sauce. Other toppings include sauerkraut, jalapeños, chili, grated cheese, coleslaw, bacon and olives. Hot dog variants include the corn dog and pigs in a blanket.

buffalo-wings.name: Buffalo wings
buffalo-wings.about: Fried chicken wings tossed in a spicy, buttery hot sauce.
steps: Chicken wings are deep-fried until the skin is crisp.
They are tossed in a sauce of melted butter and cayenne pepper hot sauce.
They are served with celery sticks and a cool blue cheese or ranch dip.
buffalo-wings.tip: Heat levels are often mild, medium, hot. Medium is already spicy for many people.

wiki_summary.extract: A Buffalo wing in American cuisine is an unbreaded chicken wing section that is generally deep-fried, then coated or dipped in a sauce consisting of a vinegar-based cayenne pepper hot sauce and melted butter. They are traditionally served hot with celery and carrot sticks and a dip of ranch dressing or blue cheese dressing.

mac-and-cheese.name: Mac and cheese
mac-and-cheese.about: Pasta in a rich, creamy cheese sauce, sometimes baked with a crunchy top.
steps: Butter and flour are cooked together, then milk is whisked in to make a white sauce.
Grated cheddar is melted into the sauce.
Cooked macaroni is mixed in, and it may be topped with breadcrumbs and baked.

wiki_summary.extract: Macaroni and cheese is a pasta dish of macaroni covered in cheese sauce, most commonly cheddar sauce. Its origins trace back to cheese and pasta casseroles in medieval England. The traditional macaroni and cheese is put in a casserole dish and baked in the oven; however, it may be prepared in a saucepan on top of the stove, sometimes using a packaged mix such as became popular in the mid-20th century. The cheese is often included as a Mornay sauce added to the pasta. It has been described as "comfort food".

cobb-salad.name: Cobb salad
cobb-salad.about: A large salad with rows of chicken, bacon, egg, avocado and blue cheese.
steps: Lettuce is chopped and spread on a plate.
Chicken, bacon, egg, avocado, tomato and blue cheese are arranged in rows on top.
It is dressed with vinaigrette just before eating.

wiki_summary.extract: The Cobb salad is an American garden salad typically made with chopped salad greens, tomato, bacon, chicken breast, hard-boiled eggs, avocado, chives, blue cheese and red wine vinaigrette. The ingredients are laid out separately, often in neat rows. It is served as a main course.

fried-chicken.name: Fried chicken
fried-chicken.about: Chicken pieces in a seasoned crunchy coating, deep-fried.
steps: Chicken is soaked in seasoned buttermilk to keep it juicy.
It is dredged in seasoned flour.
It is deep-fried until golden and cooked through.

wiki_summary.extract:
Fried chicken, more formally known as Southern fried chicken, is a dish consisting of chicken pieces, 
coated with seasoned flour or batter, that are pan-fried, deep-fried, pressure-fried, or air-fried. The breading adds a crisp coating or crust to the exterior of the chicken while retaining juices in the meat. Broiler chickens are most commonly used.

chicken-tenders.name: Chicken tenders
chicken-tenders.about: Strips of breaded, fried chicken breast with dipping sauces.
steps: Chicken breast is cut into strips.
The strips are coated in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
They are fried until crisp and served with dipping sauces.

wiki_summary.extract: Chicken tenders are chicken meat prepared from the pectoralis minor muscles of the bird. These strips of white meat are located on either side of the breastbone, under the breast meat. They may also be made with similarly shaped pieces cut from chicken meat, usually the breast, or sometimes just pulverized chicken flesh.

pancakes.name: Pancakes
pancakes.about: A stack of thick, fluffy pancakes with butter and maple syrup.
steps: Flour, milk, eggs and baking powder are mixed into a thick batter.
Rounds of batter are cooked on a buttered griddle and flipped when bubbles appear.
They are stacked and served with butter and syrup, often with berries or bacon.

wiki_summary.extract: A pancake, also known as a hotcake, griddlecake, or flapjack, is a flat type of batter bread like cake, often thin and round, prepared from a starch-based batter that may contain eggs, milk, and butter, and then cooked on a hot surface such as a griddle or frying pan. Archaeological evidence suggests that pancakes were probably eaten in prehistoric societies.

eggs-benedict.name: Eggs Benedict
eggs-benedict.about: Poached eggs and ham on an English muffin, covered in buttery hollandaise sauce.
steps: English muffin halves are toasted and topped with warm ham.
Eggs are poached in simmering water so the yolk stays runny.
Hollandaise, a warm sauce of egg yolk, butter and lemon, is poured over the top.
eggs-benedict.tip: Versions with smoked salmon ("royale") or spinach ("florentine") are common.

wiki_summary.extract: Eggs Benedict is a common American breakfast or brunch dish, consisting of two halves of an English muffin, each topped with Canadian bacon or sliced ham, a poached egg, and hollandaise sauce. The dish is believed to have originated in New York City, although a number of different origin stories exist.

french-toast.name: French toast
french-toast.about: Thick bread soaked in egg and milk, fried in butter, served sweet.
ingredients: bread such as brioche or challah
steps: Eggs, milk, sugar and cinnamon are whisked together.
Thick slices of bread are soaked in the mixture.
They are fried in butter until golden and served with syrup and fruit.

wiki_summary.extract: French toast is a dish of sliced bread soaked in beaten eggs and often milk or cream, then pan-fried. Alternative names and variants include eggy bread, Bombay toast, gypsy toast, and poor knights (of Windsor).

omelette.name: Omelette
omelette.about: Beaten eggs cooked flat and folded around fillings like cheese and vegetables.
steps: Eggs are beaten with salt.
They are poured into a hot buttered pan and stirred gently until just set.
Fillings are added and the omelette is folded in half.

wiki_summary.extract: An omelette is a dish made from eggs, fried with butter or oil in a frying pan. It is a common practice for an omelette to include fillings such as chives, vegetables, mushrooms, meat, cheese, onions or some combination of the above. Whole eggs or egg whites are often beaten with a small amount of milk, cream, or water.

avocado-toast.name: Avocado toast
avocado-toast.about: Toasted bread topped with mashed avocado, often with egg or chilli flakes.
steps: Bread is toasted.
Ripe avocado is mashed with lemon juice and salt.
It is spread on the toast and topped with chilli, seeds or a poached egg.

wiki_summary.extract: Avocado toast is an open sandwich consisting of toasted bread topped with mashed avocado, plus any of a variety of spices and flavorful ingredients; the most popular include salt and black pepper, lemon juice, or other citrus flavors, olive oil, hummus, vinegar, red pepper, feta, duqqa, and tomato.

ny-slice.name: New York slice
ny-slice.about: A large, thin, foldable slice of cheese or pepperoni pizza.
steps: Dough is stretched very thin into a wide round.
It is topped with tomato sauce and low-moisture mozzarella.
It is baked in a hot deck oven, cut into big slices and reheated when you order.
ny-slice.tip: Fold the slice in half lengthwise to eat it. A plain cheese slice is usually the cheapest meal in town.

wiki_summary.extract: New York–style pizza is a pizza made with a large hand-tossed thin crust, often sold in wide slices to go. The crust is thick and crisp only along its edge, yet soft, thin, and pliable enough beneath its toppings to be folded to eat. Traditional toppings are simply tomato sauce and shredded mozzarella cheese. This was a popular meal among poor Italian Americans due to its low cost.

margherita-pizza.name: Margherita pizza
margherita-pizza.about: Pizza with tomato, fresh mozzarella and basil.
steps: Dough is stretched by hand into a round.
It is topped with crushed tomatoes and pieces of fresh mozzarella.
It is baked very hot until the crust blisters, then finished with basil and olive oil.

wiki_summary.extract: Pizza Margherita, also known as Margherita pizza, is, together with the pizza marinara, the typical Neapolitan pizza. It is roundish in shape with a raised edge and seasoned with hand-crushed peeled tomatoes, mozzarella, fresh basil leaves, and extra virgin olive oil. The dough is made by mixing water, salt, and yeast with flour.

garlic-knots.name: Garlic knots
garlic-knots.about: Knots of pizza dough baked and coated in garlic butter.
steps: Strips of dough are tied into knots.
They are baked until golden.
They are tossed in garlic butter, parsley and parmesan.

wiki_summary.extract: Garlic knots are a type of garlic bread found primarily in pizzerias around New York City and the surrounding regions. They were developed in the 1940s in Brooklyn. Many pizzerias claim to be the progenitors of the baked good.

calzone.name: Calzone
calzone.about: Pizza dough folded over and sealed around cheese and fillings, then baked.
steps: Dough is rolled into a round.
Ricotta, mozzarella and fillings go on one half, and the dough is folded over and sealed.
It is baked and served with tomato sauce.

wiki_summary.extract: Calzone is an Italian oven-baked folded pizza. A typical calzone is made from salted bread dough, baked in an oven and stuffed with prosciutto or salami, mozzarella or ricotta, and Parmesan or pecorino, as well as an egg. Different regional variations in or on a calzone can often include other ingredients that are normally associated with pizza toppings. The term usually applies to an oven-baked folded pizza rather than a fried folded pizza, although calzones and panzerotti are often mistaken for each other.

carbonara.name: Spaghetti carbonara
carbonara.about: Pasta in a silky sauce of egg, cheese and crispy cured pork.
steps: Cured pork is cooked until crisp.
Hot pasta is tossed with the pork and its fat.
Off the heat, egg yolks and grated cheese are stirred in to make a creamy sauce without cream.

wiki_summary.extract: Carbonara is a pasta dish made with cured pork, hard cheese, eggs, salt, and black pepper. It is typical of the Lazio region of Italy. The dish took its modern form and name in the middle of the 20th century.

chicken-parm.name: Chicken parmesan
chicken-parm.about: Breaded fried chicken cutlet baked with tomato sauce and melted mozzarella.
steps: Chicken breast is pounded thin, breaded and fried.
It is covered in tomato sauce and mozzarella.
It is baked until bubbling and served with pasta or in a sandwich (a "chicken parm hero").

wiki_summary.extract: Chicken parmesan or chicken parmigiana is a dish that consists of fried breaded chicken breast covered in tomato sauce and mozzarella, Parmesan or provolone. Ham or bacon is sometimes added.

lasagna.name: Lasagna
lasagna.about: Layers of flat pasta, meat sauce, ricotta and mozzarella, baked.
steps: A slow-cooked meat and tomato sauce is made.
Pasta sheets, sauce, ricotta and mozzarella are layered in a deep pan.
It is baked until bubbling and rested before cutting.

wiki_summary.extract: Lasagna, also known by the plural form lasagne, is a type of pasta made in wide, flat sheets. It originates in Italian cuisine, where it is served in a number of ways, but is most often served as a casserole made by stacked layers of pasta, alternating with fillings that could consist of meat, dairy, vegetables, and sauces. Typically, cooked pasta is assembled with the aforementioned fillings, topped with grated cheese, and then baked in an oven. Regional variations of this are found across Italy, along with Americanized versions worldwide.

risotto.name: Risotto
risotto.about: Creamy rice slowly cooked in broth with parmesan.
steps: Onion is softened in butter and the rice is toasted in it.
Hot broth is added a ladle at a time while stirring, which releases starch and makes it creamy.
Butter and parmesan are stirred in at the end.
risotto.tip: The broth may be chicken; ask if you need it vegetarian.

wiki_summary.extract: Risotto is an Italian rice dish cooked with broth until it reaches a creamy consistency. The broth can be derived from meat, fish or vegetables. Many types of risotto contain butter, onion, white wine, and Parmesan cheese. It is one of the most common ways of cooking rice in Italy. Saffron was originally used for flavour and its signature yellow colour.

tiramisu.name: Tiramisu
tiramisu.about: A layered dessert of coffee-soaked sponge fingers and mascarpone cream.
steps: Ladyfingers are dipped in strong coffee.
They are layered with a cream of mascarpone, egg and sugar.
It is chilled for hours and dusted with cocoa.
tiramisu.tip: Often contains a little alcohol (marsala or rum).

wiki_summary.extract: Tiramisu is an Italian dessert made with coffee-soaked ladyfingers covered with a cream of egg yolks, sugar, mascarpone, and cocoa powder. It originated in northeastern Italy, and modern versions were popularized in restaurants from the late 1960s. Tiramisu has become one of the most internationally recognised Italian desserts and has inspired many variations in home and professional cooking. The name comes from the Italian tirami su, meaning 'pick me up' or 'cheer me up'.

tacos-al-pastor.name: Tacos al pastor
tacos-al-pastor.about: Small corn tortillas with marinated pork cooked on a vertical spit, with pineapple.
steps: Pork is marinated in a paste of dried chillies, spices and achiote.
It is stacked on a vertical spit and roasted, with pineapple on top.
Thin slices are shaved into warm tortillas and topped with onion, cilantro, pineapple and salsa.
tacos-al-pastor.tip: Tacos are small, so order two or three. Squeeze the lime on top.

wiki_summary.extract: Al pastor, tacos al pastor, or tacos de trompo is a preparation of sliced, spit-grilled meat, usually pork, originating in the Central Mexican region of Puebla where they remain most prominent, though it is a common menu item found in taquerías throughout Mexico. The method of preparing and cooking al pastor is based on the lamb shawarma brought by Lebanese immigrants to the region. Al pastor features a flavor palette that uses traditional Mexican adobada (marinade). It is a popular street food that has spread to the United States. In some places of northern Mexico and coastal Mexico, such as in Baja California, taco al pastor is known as taco de trompo or taco de adobada.

burrito.name: Burrito
burrito.about: A large flour tortilla wrapped around rice, beans, meat and salsa.
steps: A large flour tortilla is warmed so it folds easily.
Rice, beans, meat, cheese and salsa are piled in the middle.
The sides are folded in and it is rolled tightly, sometimes grilled to seal.

wiki_summary.extract: A burrito or burro is historically a regional name in Mexico for what in other parts of the country is known as a taco. The term burrito was regional, specifically from Guanajuato, Guerrero, Michoacán, San Luis Potosí, Sonora and Sinaloa, for what is known as a taco in Mexico City and surrounding areas, and codzito in Yucatán and Quintana Roo. Due to the cultural influence of Mexico City, the term taco became the default, and the meaning of terms like burrito and codzito were forgotten, leading many people to create new meanings and folk histories.

enchiladas.name: Enchiladas
enchiladas.about: Rolled corn tortillas filled and covered in chilli sauce and cheese.
steps: Tortillas are softened in warm oil or sauce.
They are filled with chicken, beef or cheese and rolled.
They are covered in chilli sauce and cheese and baked.

wiki_summary.extract: An enchilada is a Mexican dish consisting of a corn tortilla rolled around a filling and covered with a savory sauce. Enchiladas can be filled with various ingredients, including meats, cheese, beans, potatoes, vegetables, or combinations. Enchilada sauces include chili-based sauces, such as salsa roja, various moles, tomato-based sauces, such as salsa verde, or cheese-based sauces, such as chile con queso.

quesadilla.name: Quesadilla
quesadilla.about: A tortilla folded around melted cheese, grilled until crisp.
steps: Cheese and fillings are spread on half a tortilla.
It is folded and cooked on a griddle.
It is flipped until both sides are crisp and the cheese melts, and served with salsa.

wiki_summary.extract: A quesadilla is a Mexican dish made from a tortilla folded in half or two tortillas that are filled with cheese (queso), and sometimes meats, spices, and other fillings, and then cooked on a griddle or stove. Quesadillas are frequently sold at Mexican restaurants all over the world.

guacamole.name: Guacamole
guacamole.about: A dip of mashed avocado with lime, onion, chilli and cilantro.
steps: Ripe avocados are mashed, leaving some chunks.
Lime juice, chopped onion, chilli, cilantro and salt are mixed in.
It is served right away with tortilla chips.

wiki_summary.extract: Guacamole, sometimes informally shortened to guac in the United States, is an avocado-based dip, spread, or salad first developed in Mexico. In addition to its use in modern Mexican cuisine, it has become part of international cuisine as a dip, condiment, and salad ingredient.

elote.name: Elote
elote.about: Grilled corn on the cob with mayonnaise, cheese, chilli and lime.
steps: Corn is grilled until lightly charred.
It is spread with mayonnaise or crema.
It is rolled in crumbly cheese and sprinkled with chilli and lime.

wiki_summary.extract: Corn on the cob is a culinary term for a cooked ear of sweet corn (maize) eaten directly off the cob. Variations of the corn on the cob include the Masala Bhutta in India, Yaki-tōmorokoshi in Japan and Elote in Latin American countries.

general-tso.name: General Tso's chicken
general-tso.about: Crispy fried chicken in a sweet, tangy and slightly spicy sauce.
steps: Chicken pieces are coated in cornstarch and deep-fried until crisp.
A sauce of soy, vinegar, sugar, garlic, ginger and dried chillies is cooked in a wok until glossy.
The chicken is tossed in the sauce and served with rice and broccoli.
general-tso.tip: An American-Chinese classic, very popular in New York takeout.

wiki_summary.extract: General Tso's chicken is a Chinese-American sweet and spicy deep-fried chicken dish.

dumplings.name: Dumplings
dumplings.about: Thin dough parcels filled with pork, chicken or vegetables, steamed or pan-fried.
steps: Ground meat is mixed with chopped cabbage, scallion and ginger.
Spoonfuls are wrapped in thin dough and pleated shut.
They are boiled, steamed, or pan-fried until the bottoms crisp, and dipped in soy and vinegar.

wiki_summary.extract: Jiaozi are a type of Chinese dumpling. They typically consist of a ground meat or vegetable filling wrapped into a thinly rolled piece of dough, which is then sealed by pressing the edges together. They can be boiled, steamed, pan-fried, deep-fried, or baked, and are traditionally served with a black vinegar and soy sauce dip. They can also be served in a soup. Jiaozi have great cultural significance within China. They are one of the major dishes eaten during the Chinese New Year throughout northern China and eaten all year round in the northern provinces. Their resemblance to the gold and silver ingots (sycee) used in Imperial China has meant that they symbolize wealth and good fortune.

fried-rice.name: Fried rice
fried-rice.about: Cooked rice stir-fried in a very hot wok with egg, vegetables and meat.
steps: Egg is scrambled in a very hot wok.
Cold cooked rice is added and tossed so each grain fries.
Vegetables, meat and soy sauce are mixed in.

wiki_summary.extract: Fried rice is a dish of cooked rice that has been stir-fried in a wok or a frying pan and is usually mixed with other ingredients such as eggs, vegetables, seafood, or meat. It is often eaten as a main dish or as an accompaniment to another dish. Fried rice is a popular component of East Asian, Southeast Asian and South Asian cuisines. As a homemade dish, fried rice is typically made with ingredients left over from other dishes, leading to countless variations. Fried rice first developed during the Sui dynasty in China and later spread across the world through the migration of the Chinese diaspora.

lo-mein.name: Lo mein
lo-mein.about: Soft egg noodles tossed with vegetables, meat and a savoury soy sauce.
steps: Egg noodles are boiled and drained.
Meat and vegetables are stir-fried in a wok.
The noodles are tossed in with soy and oyster sauce until coated.

wiki_summary.extract: Lo mein is a Chinese dish with noodles. When prepared in the Cantonese style, it is often topped with or accompanied by meat, wontons, or vegetables, and may be served with a bowl of broth.

kung-pao.name: Kung pao chicken
kung-pao.about: Diced chicken stir-fried with peanuts, dried chillies and Sichuan pepper.
steps: Diced chicken is marinated in soy and cornstarch.
Dried chillies and Sichuan pepper are fried in oil, then the chicken is stir-fried.
Sauce and roasted peanuts are tossed in at the end.

wiki_summary.extract: Kung Pao chicken, also transcribed Gong Bao or Kung Po, is a spicy, stir-fried Chinese dish made with cubes of cooked chicken, peanuts, vegetables and chili peppers, and Sichuan peppercorns. From its origins in Sichuan cuisine, the dish's popularity has spread throughout China, spawning a number of regional variations—some of which are less spicy than the classic version.

mapo-tofu.name: Mapo tofu
mapo-tofu.about: Soft tofu in a fiery, numbing Sichuan sauce with minced meat.
steps: Ground meat is fried with chilli bean paste until the oil turns red.
Cubes of soft tofu and broth are added and simmered gently.
It is thickened and finished with ground Sichuan pepper, which makes your lips tingle.
mapo-tofu.tip: Vegetarian versions without meat are often available.

wiki_summary.extract: Mapo tofu is a popular Chinese dish from Sichuan province. It consists of tofu set in a spicy sauce, typically a thin, oily, and bright red suspension, based on douban, and douchi, along with minced meat, traditionally beef. Variations exist with other ingredients such as water chestnuts, onions, other vegetables, or wood ear fungus. It is likely to have originated at a Chengdu restaurant in the 1860s–1870s.

peking-duck.name: Peking duck
peking-duck.about: Roast duck with very crisp skin, eaten wrapped in thin pancakes.
steps: The duck is air-dried and glazed so the skin turns glassy and crisp when roasted.
It is roasted whole and carved at the table.
You wrap slices in a thin pancake with hoisin sauce, scallion and cucumber.
peking-duck.tip: Often ordered for a group; some restaurants need it ordered in advance.

wiki_summary.extract: Peking duck is a dish from Beijing that has been prepared since the Imperial era. The meat is characterized by its thin, crispy skin, with authentic versions of the dish serving mostly the skin and little meat, sliced in front of the diners by the cook. Ducks bred especially for the dish are slaughtered after 65 days and seasoned before being roasted in a closed or hung oven. The meat is often eaten with spring onion, cucumber, and sweet bean sauce, with pancakes rolled around the fillings. Aromatic duck is a similar dish to Peking duck and is popular in the United Kingdom and Ireland.

sushi.name: Sushi
sushi.about: Seasoned rice with raw or cooked fish, as rolls or hand-pressed pieces.
steps: Rice is cooked and seasoned with vinegar, sugar and salt.
For nigiri, a slice of fish is pressed on a small mound of rice; for rolls (maki), rice and fillings are rolled in seaweed.
It is served with soy sauce, wasabi and pickled ginger.
sushi.tip: Cooked or vegetarian rolls (California, cucumber, avocado) are good if you don't eat raw fish. Ginger is for between bites.

wiki_summary.extract: Sushi  is a traditional Japanese dish made with vinegared rice , typically seasoned with sugar and salt, and combined with a variety of ingredients , such as seafood, vegetables, or meat; raw seafood is the most common, although some may be cooked. While sushi has numerous styles and presentations, the current defining component is the vinegared rice, also known as shari (しゃり), or sumeshi (酢飯).

sashimi.name: Sashimi
sashimi.about: Slices of very fresh raw fish, served without rice.
steps: High-quality fish is chosen for eating raw.
It is cut with a very sharp knife into neat slices.
It is arranged with shredded radish and served with soy sauce and wasabi.

wiki_summary.extract: Sashimi  is a Japanese delicacy that consists of fresh raw fish or other raw meat that is sliced into thin pieces, and is often eaten with soy sauce.

miso-soup.name: Miso soup
miso-soup.about: A light savoury soup of fermented soybean paste with tofu and seaweed.
steps: Dashi broth is made from kelp and dried bonito flakes.
Miso paste is dissolved into the hot broth without boiling.
Tofu, seaweed and scallion are added.

wiki_summary.extract: Miso soup  is a traditional Japanese soup consisting of miso in a dashi stock. It is commonly served as part of an ichijū-sansai (一汁三菜) meal 'one soup, three dishes' consisting of rice, soup, and side dishes. Optional ingredients based on region and season may be added, such as wakame, tofu, negi, abura-age, and mushrooms. Along with suimono, miso soup is one of the two basic soup types of Japanese cuisine. It is a representative of soup dishes served with rice.

edamame.name: Edamame
edamame.about: Young green soybeans in the pod, boiled and salted.
steps: Soybean pods are boiled or steamed.
They are sprinkled with coarse salt.
You squeeze the beans out of the pod with your teeth; the pod isn't eaten.

wiki_summary.extract: Edamame  is an East Asian and Southeast Asia dish prepared with immature soybeans in their pods, which are boiled or steamed, and may be served with salt or other condiments. It is consumed in many world regions. Edamame is a common side dish in Chinese cuisine, Japanese cuisine, Filipino cuisine and as an appetizer to alcoholic beverages, such as beer or shōchū. As an ingredient, edamame is used in both sweet and savory dishes, such as takikomi gohan, tempura, and zunda-mochi. Edamame is called utaw in Filipino and maudou in Chinese.

ramen.name: Ramen
ramen.about: Wheat noodles in a rich broth with pork, egg and toppings.
steps: Broth is simmered for many hours from pork bones (tonkotsu), chicken, or with soy (shoyu) or miso.
Fresh noodles are boiled for about a minute.
Noodles and broth go into a bowl with sliced pork, a marinated egg and other toppings.
ramen.tip: Slurping is normal. Many shops offer a vegetarian broth.

wiki_summary.extract: Ramen   is a Japanese-Chinese fusion noodle dish. It includes Chinese-style alkaline wheat noodles  served in several flavors of hot broth. Common flavors are soy sauce and miso, with typical toppings including sliced pork , nori, lacto-fermented bamboo shoots (menma), narutomaki, and scallions. Nearly every region in Japan has its own variation of ramen, such as the tonkotsu ramen of Kyushu and the miso ramen of Hokkaido.

gyoza.name: Gyoza
gyoza.about: Japanese pan-fried dumplings, crispy on the bottom and soft on top.
steps: Pork and cabbage filling is wrapped in thin round wrappers.
They are fried on one side until golden.
Water is added and the pan covered to steam them through.

wiki_summary.extract: Jiaozi are a type of Chinese dumpling. They typically consist of a ground meat or vegetable filling wrapped into a thinly rolled piece of dough, which is then sealed by pressing the edges together. They can be boiled, steamed, pan-fried, deep-fried, or baked, and are traditionally served with a black vinegar and soy sauce dip. They can also be served in a soup. Jiaozi have great cultural significance within China. They are one of the major dishes eaten during the Chinese New Year throughout northern China and eaten all year round in the northern provinces. Their resemblance to the gold and silver ingots (sycee) used in Imperial China has meant that they symbolize wealth and good fortune.

tonkatsu.name: Tonkatsu
tonkatsu.about: A crisp breaded and fried pork cutlet with a sweet-tangy sauce.
steps: A thick pork cutlet is coated in flour, egg and panko.
It is deep-fried until golden and sliced.
It is served with shredded cabbage, rice and thick tonkatsu sauce.

wiki_summary.extract: Tonkatsu  is a type of Japanese cutlet made from pork. Slices of pork loin or fillet are coated with panko and then deep-fried in oil.

tempura.name: Tempura
tempura.about: Shrimp and vegetables in a very light, crisp batter.
ingredients: vegetables such as sweet potato and broccoli
steps: A thin batter is mixed quickly from flour and ice-cold water.
Shrimp and vegetables are dipped and fried briefly in hot oil.
They are served at once with a light soy-dashi dipping sauce.

wiki_summary.extract: Tempura  is a Japanese dish that usually consists of seafood and vegetables that have been coated in a thin batter and deep-fried. Tempura originated in the 16th century, when Portuguese Jesuits brought the Western-style cooking method of coating foods with flour and frying, via Nanban trade.

udon.name: Udon
udon.about: Thick, chewy wheat noodles in a light savoury broth.
steps: A broth is made from dashi, soy and mirin.
Thick noodles are boiled.
They are served in the broth with toppings like tempura, fried tofu or beef.

wiki_summary.extract: Udon is a thick noodle made from wheat flour, used in Japanese cuisine. There are a variety of ways it is prepared and served. Its simplest form is in a soup as kake udon with a mild broth called kakejiru made from dashi, soy sauce, and mirin. It is usually topped with thinly chopped scallions. Other common toppings include prawn tempura, kakiage, abura-age, kamaboko, and shichimi spice added to taste.

poke-bowl.name: Poke bowl
poke-bowl.about: Cubes of raw marinated fish over rice with vegetables and sauces.
steps: Raw fish is cubed and marinated in soy and sesame.
It is placed over rice or greens.
Toppings and sauces are added. Usually you pick them yourself at the counter.
poke-bowl.tip: Most shops also offer tofu or cooked chicken.

wiki_summary.extract: Poke or poké is a dish of diced raw fish tossed in sauce and served either as an appetizer or a main course.

butter-chicken.name: Butter chicken
butter-chicken.about: Tandoori chicken in a mild, creamy tomato and butter sauce.
steps: Chicken is marinated in yogurt and spices and roasted in a tandoor oven.
A sauce of tomatoes, butter, cream and spices is simmered until smooth.
The chicken is simmered in the sauce and eaten with naan or rice.
butter-chicken.tip: One of the mildest Indian dishes, a good first choice.

wiki_summary.extract: Butter chicken or murgh makhani is a curry made from chicken cooked in a spiced tomato and butter-based gravy. The gravy is known for its creamy, rich texture. It is similar to chicken tikka masala, which uses a tomato paste. The dish was invented by Indian chefs Kundan Lal Gujral and Kundan Lal Jaggi and is associated with their Moti Mahal restaurant in Daryaganj, Delhi which popularized it in the 1950s. It has since become a staple cuisine of the city.

tikka-masala.name: Chicken tikka masala
tikka-masala.about: Roasted chicken pieces in a spiced, creamy orange tomato sauce.
steps: Marinated chicken pieces (tikka) are grilled or roasted.
Onion, ginger, garlic and spices are fried, then tomatoes and cream are added.
The chicken is simmered in the sauce.
tikka-masala.tip: Restaurants usually ask how spicy you want it.

wiki_summary.extract: Chicken tikka masala is a curry consisting of roasted marinated chicken pieces in a creamy spiced sauce (masala). It is thought to have been created in Britain, possibly by Ali Ahmed Aslam in Glasgow. It is offered at restaurants around the world and in some of its forms is similar to butter chicken.

biryani.name: Biryani
biryani.about: Fragrant long-grain rice layered with spiced meat and slow-cooked.
steps: Meat is marinated in yogurt and spices.
Basmati rice is part-boiled with whole spices.
Rice and meat are layered with fried onions and saffron, sealed and cooked slowly so the flavours mix.
biryani.tip: Usually served with raita (yogurt sauce) to cool it down. Vegetable biryani is common.

wiki_summary.extract: Biryani is a mixed rice dish traditionally made with spiced meat, seafood, or vegetables. It was present in Mughal-era India, though whether it was created there is debated. It is thought to derive from a Persian rice dish, either pilau or birinj biryan. The dish makes use of slow-cooking as in Persian pilau, combined with Persian-style yoghurt-marinated meat and a spicy Indian style of cooking; it was likely developed in the Mughal court kitchens. It is also possible that biryani was brought to South India before the Mughal era, or that pilau was brought to India and biryani was developed from it before being adopted by the Mughals.

chana-masala.name: Chana masala
chana-masala.about: Chickpeas simmered in a tangy, spiced onion and tomato sauce.
steps: Onion, ginger and garlic are fried until brown.
Tomatoes and spices are cooked down into a thick sauce.
Chickpeas are simmered in it until soft.

wiki_summary.extract: Chana masala is a chickpea curry cooked in a tomato-based sauce, originating from the Indian subcontinent. It is a staple dish in Indian and Pakistani cuisine. It is often eaten with bread, including deep-fried bhatura, puri, or flatbreads such as kulcha.

palak-paneer.name: Palak paneer
palak-paneer.about: Cubes of fresh Indian cheese in a smooth spiced spinach sauce.
steps: Spinach is blanched and blended to a smooth purée.
Onion, garlic, ginger and spices are fried, then the spinach is added.
Cubes of paneer are warmed in the sauce.

wiki_summary.extract: Palak paneer or palak chhena is a dish from the Indian subcontinent consisting of chhena or paneer in a thick paste made from puréed spinach, called palak in Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi and other Indian languages.

samosa.name: Samosa
samosa.about: A crisp fried pastry triangle filled with spiced potato and peas.
steps: Potatoes are boiled and mashed with peas and spices.
The filling is wrapped in pastry cones and sealed.
They are deep-fried and served with sweet tamarind and green mint chutney.

wiki_summary.extract: A samosa or shingara is a fried Indian subcontinent turnover with a savoury filling that mostly consists of vegetables like spiced potatoes, onions, and peas, but can include cheese such as paneer, meat or even fish. Its name originates from the Middle Persian word sambosag (سنبوسگ). It is made in different shapes, including a triangle, a cone, or a crescent, depending on the region. Samosas are often accompanied by chutney and have origins in the Middle Ages or earlier. Sweet versions containing traditional Indian flavours, or even chocolate, are also made. Samosas are popular snacks in South Asia and within the Indian diaspora across the world.

naan.name: Naan
naan.about: Soft, puffy flatbread baked on the wall of a tandoor oven.
steps: A soft dough is made with flour, yogurt and yeast.
It is stretched and slapped onto the hot inside wall of a clay tandoor.
It puffs and chars in a minute and is brushed with butter.
naan.tip: Tear off pieces to scoop up curry instead of using a fork.

wiki_summary.extract: Naan is a leavened, oven-baked or tawa-fried flatbread, that can also be baked in a tandoor. It is characterised by a light and fluffy texture and golden-brown spots from the baking process. Naan is used in many cuisines worldwide.

masala-dosa.name: Masala dosa
masala-dosa.about: A large, thin, crisp fermented rice crêpe filled with spiced potatoes.
steps: Rice and lentils are soaked, ground and fermented overnight into a batter.
The batter is spread thin on a hot griddle until crisp.
It is filled with spiced potato and served with sambar (lentil soup) and coconut chutney.

wiki_summary.extract: Masala dosa is a dish of South India, consisting of a savoury dosa crepe stuffed with a spiced potato stir fry. It is a popular breakfast item in South India, though it can be served at all times of the day and found in many other parts of the country and overseas.

chicken-karahi.name: Chicken karahi
chicken-karahi.about: Chicken cooked fast in a wok-like pan with tomato, ginger and green chilli.
steps: Chicken is seared in a karahi (a deep iron pan).
Tomatoes, ginger and garlic are cooked down with it over high heat.
It is finished with green chillies, ginger and cilantro and eaten with naan.

wiki_summary.extract: A karahi is a type of thick, circular, and deep cooking pot, similar in shape to a wok, from the Indian subcontinent. It is used in Indian, Nepalese, Sri Lankan, Pakistani, Bangladeshi, Afghan, and Caribbean cuisines. Traditionally press-formed from mild steel sheets or made of wrought iron, a karahi resembles a wok with steeper sides. Today, they can be made of stainless steel, copper, and nonstick surfaces, both round and flat-bottomed, or of traditional materials. The word karahi emanates from karah, a bigger version of karahi traditionally used in the subcontinent for boiling milk and producing thick cream.

nihari.name: Nihari
nihari.about: A slow-cooked, deeply spiced beef stew.
steps: Beef is slow-cooked overnight with a blend of warm spices.
The gravy is thickened with toasted flour.
It is served topped with ginger, chilli, cilantro and lemon, with naan.

wiki_summary.extract: Nihari is a stew of the Indian subcontinent, which consists of slow-cooked meat, mainly a shank cut of beef, lamb and mutton, or goat meat, as well as chicken and bone marrow. The two most common theories of origin postulate that nihari originated in the Indian subcontinent during the era of Mughal Empire either in the cities of Lucknow or Delhi. It is flavoured with long pepper (pippali), a relative of black pepper and is often served with naan, roti or rice.

seekh-kebab.name: Seekh kebab
seekh-kebab.about: Spiced minced meat shaped on skewers and grilled over charcoal.
steps: Ground meat is mixed with onion, herbs and spices.
It is pressed in long rolls around metal skewers.
It is grilled over charcoal and served with onion, lemon and mint chutney.

wiki_summary.extract: Seekh kebab is a type of kebab from the Indian subcontinent. It is made with Indian spices, spiced minced or ground meat, usually lamb, beef, or chicken, formed into cylinders on skewers and grilled. It is typically cooked on a mangal or barbecue, or in a tandoor. Seekh kebabs are prepared in homes and restaurants throughout the Indian subcontinent.

momo.name: Momo
momo.about: Himalayan steamed dumplings with a spiced filling and tomato chutney.
steps: Spiced meat or vegetable filling is wrapped in thin dough and pleated.
The dumplings are steamed in stacked baskets.
They are served with a spicy tomato and sesame dipping sauce.

wiki_summary.extract: Momos are a type of steamed, filled dumpling in Nepalese and Tibetan cuisine, also popular in neighbouring Bangladesh, Bhutan, and India. They are usually served with a dipping sauce known as achar or chutney. They can also be served in soup, such as jhol momo or mokthuk.

thukpa.name: Thukpa
thukpa.about: A hearty Tibetan noodle soup with vegetables and meat.
steps: Broth is simmered with garlic, ginger and spices.
Vegetables and meat are cooked in it.
Noodles are added, and it is served hot.

wiki_summary.extract: Thukpa is a Tibetan noodle soup, which originated in the eastern part of Tibet. Amdo thukpa, especially thenthuk, is a variant among the Indians, especially Ladakhis and the Sikkimese. Thukpa can be prepared in both vegetarian and non-vegetarian variations; the most popular non-vegetarian variation includes chicken.

dal-bhat.name: Dal bhat
dal-bhat.about: Nepal's everyday meal of lentil soup and rice with vegetable curry and pickle.
steps: Lentils are simmered with turmeric and tempered with fried spices.
Rice is steamed.
They are served on one plate with vegetable curry, greens and pickle.

wiki_summary.extract: Dal bhat, also known as dal chawal, is a legume and rice dish which consists of thick soup called dal (lentils) and cooked rice called bhat (rice). It is a traditional meal in South Asia and one of the most common everyday meals in the region and in the Caribbean. The meal is simple, nutritious, and widely eaten as a daily staple food. The combination of dal and bhat is valued because it provides both protein and carbohydrates, making it a balanced and filling meal.

pad-thai.name: Pad thai
pad-thai.about: Stir-fried rice noodles with egg, tamarind sauce, bean sprouts and peanuts.
steps: Soaked rice noodles are stir-fried in a hot wok with egg and shrimp, chicken or tofu.
A sweet-sour sauce of tamarind, fish sauce and palm sugar is added.
It is tossed with bean sprouts and chives and served with crushed peanuts and lime.
pad-thai.tip: Contains peanuts and usually fish sauce.

wiki_summary.extract: Pad thai is a stir-fried rice noodle dish commonly served as a street food in Thailand as part of Thai cuisine. It is typically made with rice noodles, shrimp, peanuts, green onions, scrambled egg, sugar and bean sprouts. The ingredients are fried in a wok.

green-curry.name: Green curry
green-curry.about: A creamy coconut curry made with green chilli paste and Thai basil.
steps: Green curry paste is fried in thick coconut cream until fragrant.
Chicken and vegetables are simmered in coconut milk.
It is seasoned with fish sauce and sugar and finished with Thai basil; eaten with jasmine rice.
green-curry.tip: Thai "medium" can be hot. Ask for mild if unsure.

wiki_summary.extract: Green curry is a variety of curry originating from central Thailand.

tom-yum.name: Tom yum
tom-yum.about: A hot and sour soup with lemongrass, lime and shrimp.
steps: Broth is simmered with lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves.
Shrimp and mushrooms are cooked in it briefly.
It is seasoned with lime juice, fish sauce and chilli paste.
tom-yum.tip: Don't eat the lemongrass and galangal pieces; they're only for flavour.

wiki_summary.extract: Tom yum or tom yam is a family of hot and sour Thai soups. The name tom yam is composed of two words in the Thai language: tom refers to the boiling process, while yam means "mixed".

pad-see-ew.name: Pad see ew
pad-see-ew.about: Wide rice noodles stir-fried with dark soy sauce, egg and Chinese broccoli.
steps: Meat and garlic are stir-fried in a very hot wok.
Wide noodles and egg are added and allowed to char a little.
It is tossed with sweet dark soy and Chinese broccoli.

wiki_summary.extract: Pad see ew is a stir-fried noodle dish that is commonly eaten in Thailand. It can be found easily among street food vendors and is also common in Thai restaurants around the world. The origins of the dish can be traced to China, from where the noodle stir-frying technique was brought.

massaman-curry.name: Massaman curry
massaman-curry.about: A mild, rich curry with coconut, potatoes, peanuts and warm spices.
steps: Curry paste with cardamom, cinnamon and cloves is fried in coconut cream.
Meat and potatoes are simmered in coconut milk until tender.
It is finished with peanuts, tamarind and palm sugar.

wiki_summary.extract: Massaman curry is a Thai dish consisting of potatoes, onions, peanuts, and massaman curry paste cooked in coconut milk, generally with chicken added. It is a fusion dish, combining foreign ingredients from three regions — Persia, India, and the Malay Archipelago — with ingredients more commonly used in native Thai cuisine to make massaman curry paste. The substance of the dish is usually based on chicken, potatoes, onions, and peanuts. The richness comes from the coconut milk and cream used as a base, as for many Thai curries.

mango-sticky-rice.name: Mango sticky rice
mango-sticky-rice.about: Sweet sticky rice with fresh mango and coconut cream.
steps: Glutinous rice is soaked and steamed.
It is mixed with warm sweetened coconut milk.
It is served with sliced mango and more coconut cream.

wiki_summary.extract: Mango sticky rice is a traditional Southeast Asian and South Asian dessert made with glutinous rice, fresh mango and coconut milk.

bibimbap.name: Bibimbap
bibimbap.about: A rice bowl topped with vegetables, beef, a fried egg and chilli paste, mixed before eating.
steps: Vegetables like spinach, carrot, bean sprouts and mushroom are cooked and seasoned separately.
They are arranged over rice with beef and a fried egg.
Often served in a hot stone bowl (dolsot) so the rice gets crispy; you mix in gochujang.
bibimbap.tip: Mix everything together before eating. Easy to get vegetarian.

wiki_summary.extract: Bibimbap, sometimes romanised as bi bim bap or bi bim bop, is a Korean rice dish. It is served as a bowl of warm white rice topped with namul and gochujang. Egg and sliced meat are common additions, stirred together thoroughly just before eating. The term bibim means "mixing" and bap is cooked rice.

korean-fried-chicken.name: Korean fried chicken
korean-fried-chicken.about: Extra-crispy double-fried chicken, plain or glazed in sweet-spicy sauce.
steps: Chicken is coated in a thin starch batter.
It is fried twice, which makes the skin very thin and crackly.
It is served plain or glazed in soy-garlic or sweet-spicy sauce.

wiki_summary.extract: Korean fried chicken, in Korean chikin, refers to a variety of fried chicken dishes created in South Korea. These include the basic huraideu-chicken and the spicy yangnyeom chicken. In South Korea, fried chicken is consumed as a meal, an appetizer, anju, or as an after-meal snack.

bulgogi.name: Bulgogi
bulgogi.about: Thin slices of beef marinated in sweet soy and grilled.
steps: Thinly sliced beef is marinated in soy, pear, garlic and sesame oil.
It is grilled or pan-cooked quickly.
It is eaten with rice, or wrapped in lettuce leaves with sauce.

wiki_summary.extract: Bulgogi is a gui made of thin, marinated slices of meat, most commonly beef, grilled on a barbecue or on a stove-top griddle. It is also often stir-fried in a pan in home cooking. Sirloin and rib eye are frequently used cuts of beef for the dish. Bulgogi is a very popular dish in South Korea, where it can be found anywhere from upscale restaurants to local supermarkets as pan-ready kits.

kimchi-jjigae.name: Kimchi stew
kimchi-jjigae.about: A bubbling, spicy stew of aged kimchi, pork and tofu.
steps: Pork and well-fermented kimchi are fried together.
Water or broth is added with chilli flakes and simmered.
Tofu is added and it is served boiling hot with rice.

wiki_summary.extract: Kimchi-jjigae (Korean: 김치찌개) or kimchi stew is a jjigae, or stew-like Korean dish, made with kimchi and other ingredients, such as pork, scallions, onions, and diced tofu. It is one of the most common stews in Korean cuisine.

tteokbokki.name: Tteokbokki
tteokbokki.about: Chewy rice cakes in a sweet and spicy red chilli sauce.
steps: A sauce of gochujang, chilli and sugar is simmered in broth.
Cylinder-shaped rice cakes and fish cakes are cooked in it until soft and chewy.
It is served with boiled egg and scallion.

wiki_summary.extract: Tteokbokki , topokki or simmered rice cake, is a Korean food made from small-sized garae-tteok called tteokmyeon or commonly tteokbokki-tteok. It is often paired with eomuk, boiled eggs, and scallions, and seasoned with spicy gochujang. Less often, it is served in a non-spicy ganjang-based (soy) sauce, which is sometimes called gungjung-tteokbokki.

pho.name: Pho
pho.about: A fragrant beef broth with rice noodles, thin beef slices and fresh herbs.
steps: Beef bones are simmered for hours with charred onion, ginger and spices like star anise.
Rice noodles and thin raw beef go into a bowl, and the boiling broth cooks the beef.
You add basil, bean sprouts, lime, chilli, hoisin and sriracha yourself.
pho.tip: Say it "fuh". Chicken pho (pho ga) is common too.

wiki_summary.extract: Pho is a Vietnamese soup dish consisting of broth, rice noodles, herbs, and meat – usually beef, and sometimes chicken. Pho is a popular food in Vietnam where it is served in households, street-stalls, and restaurants nationwide. Residents of the city of Nam Định were the first to create Vietnamese traditional pho.

banh-mi.name: Banh mi
banh-mi.about: A Vietnamese sandwich on a crisp baguette with pork, pickles and herbs.
steps: A light, crusty baguette is split and spread with pâté and mayonnaise.
It is filled with grilled pork or cold cuts.
It is topped with pickled vegetables, cucumber, cilantro and chilli.

wiki_summary.extract: In Vietnamese cuisine, bánh mì, bánh mỳ or banh mi, is a short baguette with thin, crisp crust and a soft, airy texture. Similar to a submarine sandwich, it is often split lengthwise and filled with meat and savory ingredients and served as a meal, called bánh mì thịt. Plain bánh mì is also eaten as a staple food.

spring-rolls.name: Fresh spring rolls
spring-rolls.about: Rice paper rolls with shrimp, herbs and noodles, served cold with peanut sauce.
steps: Rice paper is softened in warm water.
Shrimp, noodles, lettuce and herbs are laid on it.
It is rolled tightly and served cold with peanut-hoisin dipping sauce.

wiki_summary.extract: Gỏi cuốn, nem cuốn, salad roll, summer roll, fresh spring roll, or rice paper roll is a Vietnamese dish traditionally consisting of pork, prawn, vegetables, bún, and other ingredients wrapped in bánh tráng.

bun-cha.name: Bun cha
bun-cha.about: Grilled pork patties in a sweet-tangy dipping broth with rice noodles and herbs.
steps: Marinated pork patties and pork belly are grilled over charcoal.
They are served in a bowl of fish sauce, lime and sugar dressing.
You dip noodles and herbs into the bowl and eat everything together.

wiki_summary.extract: Bún chả is a Vietnamese dish of grilled pork and noodles, which is thought to have originated from Hanoi, Vietnam. Bún chả is served with grilled fatty pork (chả) over a plate of white rice noodles (bún) and herbs with a side dish of dipping sauce. The dish was described in 1959 by Vietnamese food writer Vũ Bằng (1913–1984), who described Hanoi as a town "transfixed by bún chả". Hanoi's first bún chả restaurant was on Gia Ngư, Hoàn Kiếm District, in Hanoi's Old Quarter.

adobo.name: Chicken adobo
adobo.about: Chicken or pork braised in vinegar, soy sauce, garlic and bay leaves.
steps: Meat is marinated in vinegar, soy and garlic.
It is simmered in the marinade with bay leaves and peppercorns until tender.
It is often browned at the end and served with rice.

wiki_summary.extract: Adobo is a popular Filipino dish and cooking process in Philippine cuisine. In its base form, meat, seafood, or vegetables are first browned in oil, and then marinated and simmered in vinegar, salt and/or soy sauce, and garlic. It is often considered the unofficial national dish in the Philippines.

lumpia.name: Lumpia
lumpia.about: Thin, crisp Filipino spring rolls filled with pork and vegetables.
steps: Ground pork and vegetables are mixed.
The filling is rolled tightly in thin wrappers.
They are fried until golden and served with sweet chilli sauce.

wiki_summary.extract: Lumpia (in Indonesian and Filipino) are various types of spring rolls commonly found in Indonesian and Filipino cuisines. Lumpia are made of thin paper-like or crêpe-like pastry skin called "lumpia wrapper" enveloping savory or sweet fillings. It is often served as an appetizer or snack, and might be served deep-fried or fresh (unfried). Lumpia are Indonesian and Filipino adaptations of the Fujianese lūn-piáⁿ (潤餅) and Teochew popiah (薄餅), usually consumed during Qingming Festival.

pancit.name: Pancit
pancit.about: Stir-fried noodles with vegetables and meat, a Filipino party dish.
steps: Meat and vegetables are stir-fried.
Noodles and broth are added and cooked until absorbed.
It is served with calamansi (a small citrus) to squeeze on top.

wiki_summary.extract: Pancit, also spelled pansit, is a general term referring to various traditional noodle dishes in Filipino cuisine. There are numerous types of pancit, often named based on the noodles used, method of cooking, place of origin or the ingredients. Most pancit dishes are served with calamansi, which adds a citrusy flavor.

sisig.name: Sisig
sisig.about: Chopped crispy pork served sizzling with onion, chilli and calamansi.
steps: Pork is boiled, then grilled until crisp.
It is chopped finely with onion and chilli.
It is served on a sizzling iron plate, often with a raw egg stirred in.

wiki_summary.extract: Sisig is a Filipino dish made from pork jowl and ears (maskara), which is usually seasoned with calamansi, onions, and chili peppers. It originates from the Pampanga region in Luzon.

nasi-lemak.name: Nasi lemak
nasi-lemak.about: Coconut rice with spicy sambal, crispy anchovies, peanuts and egg.
steps: Rice is cooked in coconut milk with pandan leaf.
Sambal chilli sauce is slow-fried until dark.
The rice is served with sambal, anchovies, peanuts, egg and cucumber, often with fried chicken.

wiki_summary.extract: Nasi lemak is a dish originating in Malay cuisine that consists of rice cooked in coconut milk and pandan leaf. It is commonly found in Malaysia, where it is considered the national dish. As it is common throughout the Malay world, it is also a native dish in neighbouring areas with significant ethnic Malay populations, such as Singapore and Southern Thailand. In Indonesia, it can be found in parts of Sumatra, especially the Malay regions of Riau, Riau Islands, and Medan. Nasi lemak can also be found in the neighbouring Philippines as well as in Australia's external territories of Christmas Island and Cocos (Keeling) Islands.

satay.name: Satay
satay.about: Grilled skewers of marinated meat with peanut sauce.
steps: Meat is marinated in lemongrass, turmeric and spices.
It is threaded on skewers and grilled over charcoal.
It is served with a sweet-spicy peanut sauce.

wiki_summary.extract: Satay or sate is a Southeast Asian dish consisting of small pieces of seasoned meat, seafood or vegetables skewered on sticks and grilled over charcoal. It is typically served with a sauce, most commonly peanut-based and accompanied by rice cakes, cucumber or pickled vegetables. Common ingredients include chicken, beef, goat, pork and seafood, while regional and vegetarian variations are also found.

laksa.name: Laksa
laksa.about: A spicy coconut curry noodle soup with shrimp and tofu.
steps: Laksa paste of chilli, shrimp paste and spices is fried.
Broth and coconut milk are added and simmered.
It is poured over noodles with shrimp, tofu and bean sprouts.

wiki_summary.extract: Laksa is a spicy noodle dish popular in Southeast Asia. Laksa consists of various types of noodles, most commonly thick rice noodles, with toppings such as chicken, prawns or fish. Most variations of laksa are prepared with a rich and spicy coconut curry soup or a broth seasoned with a souring ingredient like tamarind or asam gelugur.

gyro.name: Gyro
gyro.about: Meat roasted on a vertical spit, sliced into warm pita with tzatziki.
steps: Seasoned meat is stacked on a vertical rotisserie and roasted.
Thin slices are shaved off.
They are wrapped in warm pita with tzatziki (yogurt-cucumber sauce), tomato and onion.
gyro.tip: In New York, "gyro" from a halal cart is usually lamb-beef.

wiki_summary.extract: Gyros, sometimes anglicized as a gyro, is a Greek dish consisting of meat cooked on a vertical rotisserie, then sliced and served wrapped or stuffed in pita bread, along with other ingredients such as tomato, onion, fried potatoes, and tzatziki. In Greece and Cyprus, authentic gyros is traditionally made with pork, though chicken is occasionally used as an alternative. Ground beef and lamb are sometimes used in other countries.

souvlaki.name: Souvlaki
souvlaki.about: Grilled skewers of marinated pork or chicken.
steps: Meat is marinated in olive oil, lemon and oregano.
It is threaded onto skewers and grilled.
It is served on the skewer or in pita with tzatziki.

wiki_summary.extract: Souvlaki is a Greek food consisting of small pieces of meat and sometimes vegetables grilled on a skewer. It is usually eaten straight off the skewer while still hot. It can be served with or inside a rolled pita, typically with lemon, sauces, vegetables such as sliced tomato and onion, and fried potatoes as a side. The meat usually used in Greece and Cyprus is pork.

greek-salad.name: Greek salad
greek-salad.about: Tomato, cucumber, onion, olives and a slab of feta with olive oil.
steps: Vegetables are cut into chunks.
They are topped with olives and a block of feta cheese.
It is dressed with olive oil and oregano.

wiki_summary.extract: Greek salad, choriatiki or horiatiki is a salad in Greek cuisine generally made with pieces of tomatoes, cucumbers, onion, feta cheese, and olives and dressed with salt, Greek oregano, and olive oil. Common additions include lemon juice, green bell pepper, caper berries, and mint or parsley for decoration. Greek salad is often imagined as a farmer's breakfast or lunch, as its ingredients resemble those that a Greek farmer might have on hand.

moussaka.name: Moussaka
moussaka.about: Baked layers of eggplant, spiced meat sauce and creamy béchamel.
steps: Eggplant slices are fried or roasted.
They are layered with a meat sauce spiced with cinnamon.
It is topped with thick béchamel and baked until golden.

wiki_summary.extract: Moussaka is an aubergine (eggplant)- or potato-based dish, often including ground meat, which is common in the Balkans and the Middle East, with many local and regional variations.

spanakopita.name: Spanakopita
spanakopita.about: Flaky filo pastry pie filled with spinach and feta.
steps: Spinach is wilted and mixed with feta, herbs and egg.
It is layered between sheets of filo brushed with oil.
It is baked until crisp and golden.

wiki_summary.extract: Savory spinach pie is a pastry eaten throughout Greece, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Turkey. Of Greek origin, this pastry’s filling is made of chopped spinach and usually feta or white cheese, and egg.

falafel.name: Falafel
falafel.about: Crispy fried balls of ground chickpeas and herbs, often in pita.
steps: Soaked (not cooked) chickpeas are ground with herbs, onion and spices.
The mixture is formed into balls or patties.
They are deep-fried until crisp and served in pita with salad and tahini.

wiki_summary.extract: Falafel is a deep-fried ball or patty-shaped fritter of Egyptian origin that features in Middle Eastern cuisine, particularly Levantine cuisines. It is made from ground fava beans, chickpeas, or both, and mixed with herbs and spices before frying.

hummus.name: Hummus
hummus.about: A smooth dip of chickpeas, tahini, lemon and garlic.
steps: Chickpeas are cooked until very soft.
They are blended with tahini, lemon and garlic until silky.
It is served with olive oil on top and eaten with pita.

wiki_summary.extract: Hummus is a Levantine dip, spread, or savory dish made from cooked, mashed chickpeas blended with tahini, lemon juice, and garlic. The standard garnish includes olive oil, a few whole chickpeas, parsley, and paprika.

shawarma.name: Shawarma
shawarma.about: Spiced meat roasted on a vertical spit, wrapped in flatbread with garlic sauce.
steps: Meat is marinated with spices like cumin, cardamom and turmeric.
It is stacked on a vertical spit and roasted slowly.
Shaved slices are wrapped in flatbread with garlic sauce, pickles and vegetables.

wiki_summary.extract: Shawarma is a popular street food in the Middle East that originated in the Levant during the Ottoman Empire. It consists of meat cut into thin slices, stacked in an inverted cone, and roasted on a slow-turning vertical spit. Traditionally made with lamb or mutton, it may also be made with chicken, turkey meat, beef, falafel or veal. The surface of the rotisserie meat is routinely shaved off once it cooks and is ready to be served. Shawarma is a popular street food throughout the world.

doner-kebab.name: Döner kebab
doner-kebab.about: Turkish spit-roasted meat in bread or on a plate with salad and sauce.
steps: Seasoned meat is stacked on a vertical rotating spit.
It is roasted and thinly sliced.
It is served in bread or over rice with salad and sauces.

wiki_summary.extract: Doner kebab or döner kebab is a Turkish dish made of meat cooked on a vertical rotisserie. Seasoned meat stacked in the shape of an inverted cone is turned slowly on the rotisserie, next to a vertical cooking element. The operator uses a knife to slice thin shavings from the outer layer of the meat as it cooks. The vertical rotisserie was invented in the 19th-century Ottoman Empire, and dishes such as the Arab shawarma, Greek gyros, Greek-Canadian donair, and Mexican al pastor are derived from the rotisserie technique of this dish.

baba-ghanoush.name: Baba ghanoush
baba-ghanoush.about: A smoky dip of roasted eggplant with tahini and lemon.
steps: Eggplant is roasted over a flame until the skin chars and the inside is soft.
The flesh is scooped out and mashed.
It is mixed with tahini, lemon and garlic.

wiki_summary.extract: Baba ghanoush, also spelled baba ganoush or baba ghanouj, is a Levantine appetizer consisting of finely chopped roasted eggplant (aubergine), olive oil, lemon juice, various seasonings, and tahini. The eggplant is traditionally roasted, baked or broiled over an open flame before peeling so that the pulp is soft and has a smoky taste. It is a typical meze (starter) of the regional cuisine, often served as a side to a main meal and as a dip for pita bread.

tabbouleh.name: Tabbouleh
tabbouleh.about: A fresh herb salad of parsley, bulgur, tomato, mint and lemon.
steps: Bulgur is soaked until tender.
Lots of parsley, mint, tomato and onion are finely chopped.
It is dressed with lemon and olive oil.

wiki_summary.extract: Tabbouleh, also transcribed tabouleh, tabbouli, tabouli, or taboulah, is a Levantine salad of finely chopped parsley, soaked bulgur, tomatoes, mint, and onion, seasoned with olive oil, lemon juice, salt and sweet pepper. Some variations add lettuce, or use semolina instead of bulgur.

baklava.name: Baklava
baklava.about: Layers of thin pastry and chopped nuts, soaked in syrup or honey.
steps: Filo sheets are brushed with butter and layered with chopped nuts.
It is cut into diamonds and baked until crisp.
Hot syrup is poured over and left to soak in.

wiki_summary.extract: Baklava is a layered pastry dessert made of filo pastry, filled with chopped nuts, and sweetened with either syrup or honey.

chicken-over-rice.name: Chicken over rice
chicken-over-rice.about: New York halal cart classic, spiced chicken on yellow rice with white sauce and hot sauce.
steps: Chicken is marinated with spices and cooked on a flat griddle, then chopped.
It is piled on yellow rice with lettuce and tomato.
It is covered with creamy white sauce and red hot sauce.
chicken-over-rice.tip: The red sauce is very hot. Ask for "a little hot sauce". "Combo" means chicken and lamb.

wiki_summary.extract: A halal cart is a food cart which serves primarily halal food, particularly in New York City, but also in other metropolitan areas in the United States. A halal cart platter consists of chicken shawarma or lamb gyro, yellow rice, and salad, with optional red and/or white sauce on top. The red sauce is believed to derive from harissa, while the white sauce may come khyar bi Laban.

tagine.name: Tagine
tagine.about: A slow-cooked Moroccan stew with warm spices, often with olives or dried fruit.
steps: Meat is browned with onion and spices.
It is cooked slowly in a cone-lidded clay pot that keeps it moist.
Preserved lemon and olives, or dried fruit and almonds, are added.

wiki_summary.extract: A tagine or tajine, also tajin or tagin is a Moroccan stew, named for the earthenware pot in which it is cooked. The pot consists of two parts: a shallow, circular clay skillet and a tall cone- or dome-shaped cover. This cover captures and returns condensation during cooking, so the ingredients are braised with minimal water. The stew typically combines spiced meat, poultry or fish with vegetables or fruit. Tagine recipes include tajine zitoun, tajine mtewem, and tajine lham-lahlou.

couscous.name: Couscous
couscous.about: Tiny steamed semolina grains served with a stew of vegetables and meat.
steps: Couscous grains are steamed until light and fluffy.
Meat and vegetables are simmered in a spiced broth.
The stew is spooned over the couscous.

wiki_summary.extract: Couscous, is a traditional North African dish of small steamed granules of rolled semolina that is often served with a stew spooned on top. Pearl millet, sorghum, bulgur, and other cereals are often cooked in much the same way in West Africa, and the resulting dishes are sometimes called couscous in English, French, and Hassaniya Arabic.

shakshuka.name: Shakshuka
shakshuka.about: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce, eaten with bread.
steps: Onion, peppers and garlic are softened with spices.
Tomatoes are added and simmered into a thick sauce.
Eggs are cracked in and gently poached in the sauce.

wiki_summary.extract: Shakshouka is a Maghrebi dish of eggs poached in a sauce of tomatoes, olive oil, peppers, onion, and garlic, commonly spiced with cumin, paprika, and cayenne pepper. Shakshouka is a popular dish throughout North Africa and the Middle East.

injera.name: Injera platter
injera.about: A big spongy sour flatbread topped with stews, used to scoop up the food.
steps: Teff flour batter is fermented for several days.
It is cooked on one side on a large griddle, forming a bubbly, spongy surface.
It is covered with portions of different stews and eaten by hand.
injera.tip: Eat with your right hand, tearing off injera to pick up the stews. A "veggie combo" is a great sampler.

wiki_summary.extract: Injera, also known as taita, is a sour fermented pancake-like flatbread with a slightly spongy texture, traditionally made of teff flour. In Ethiopia, injera is a staple. Injera is central to the dining process in Amhara society, like bread or rice elsewhere, and is usually stored in the mesob.

doro-wat.name: Doro wat
doro-wat.about: Ethiopia's spicy chicken stew with berbere and a hard-boiled egg.
steps: Lots of onions are cooked slowly without oil until deeply browned.
Spiced butter and berbere (a hot red spice blend) are added.
Chicken and eggs are simmered in the sauce.

wiki_summary.extract: Wat or wet or ito or tsebhi is an Ethiopian and Eritrean stew that may be prepared with chicken, beef, lamb, a variety of vegetables, spice mixtures such as berbere , and niter kibbeh, a seasoned clarified butter.

misir-wat.name: Misir wat
misir-wat.about: Red lentils stewed with berbere spice, a vegan Ethiopian staple.
steps: Onions are cooked down with garlic and berbere.
Red lentils and water are added.
It is simmered until thick and soft.

wiki_summary.extract: Wat or wet or ito or tsebhi is an Ethiopian and Eritrean stew that may be prepared with chicken, beef, lamb, a variety of vegetables, spice mixtures such as berbere , and niter kibbeh, a seasoned clarified butter.

tibs.name: Tibs
tibs.about: Pan-fried beef or lamb with onion, rosemary and chilli.
steps: Cubes of meat are seared quickly in a hot pan.
Onion, chilli and rosemary are added with spiced butter.
It is served sizzling with injera.

wiki_summary.extract: Ethiopian cuisine characteristically consists of vegetable and often very spicy meat dishes. This is usually in the form of wat, a thick stew, served on top of injera (እንጀራ), a large sourdough flatbread, which is about 50 centimeters in diameter and made out of fermented teff flour. Ethiopians usually eat with their right hands, using pieces of injera to pick up bites of entrées and side dishes.

jollof-rice.name: Jollof rice
jollof-rice.about: West African rice cooked in a smoky, spicy tomato and pepper sauce.
steps: Tomatoes, peppers and onion are blended and fried into a thick base.
Rice and stock are added and cooked slowly in the sauce.
The bottom is allowed to char slightly for a smoky flavour.

wiki_summary.extract: Jollof, or jollof rice, is a rice dish from Senegal, West Africa. It is typically made with long-grain rice, tomatoes, chilis, onions, spices, and sometimes other vegetables and/or meat in a single pot, although its ingredients and preparation methods vary across different regions.

suya.name: Suya
suya.about: Nigerian grilled beef skewers coated in a spicy peanut spice mix.
steps: Thin beef strips are coated in yaji spice.
They are skewered and grilled over an open flame.
They are served with raw onion, tomato and more spice.

wiki_summary.extract: Suya, also known as Tsire, is a traditional Hausa (Nigerian) smoke-grilled spiced meat on skewer. Suya is generally made with thin-sliced spiced beef, lamb, goat, ram, or chicken arranged on wooden skewers. Organ meats such as kidney, liver and tripe as well as other types of meats and seafood (shrimp) are also sometimes used. Suya is most popular as evening street food or snack, restaurant appetizer, and as accompaniment with drinks at bars and night spots.

fufu.name: Fufu with soup
fufu.about: A soft, stretchy dough of cassava or yam eaten with rich soups.
ingredients: soup such as egusi or light soup
steps: Cassava or yam is boiled and pounded into a smooth, stretchy dough.
It is shaped into balls.
You pinch off a piece, dip it in the soup and swallow without much chewing.

wiki_summary.extract: Fufu is a pounded meal found in West African cuisine originally made from boiled cassava, plantains, and cocoyam. Fufu's prevalence in West Africa has been noted in local literature, such as Chinua Achebe's Things Fall Apart.

steak-frites.name: Steak frites
steak-frites.about: Pan-seared steak with French fries and a butter or pepper sauce.
steps: Steak is seared in a very hot pan and basted with butter.
It is rested and sliced.
It is served with fries and a sauce like béarnaise.

wiki_summary.extract: Steak frites, meaning "steak [and] chipped potatoes" in French, is a dish consisting of beefsteak accompanied by fried chipped potatoes. It is commonly served in Belgian and French brasseries, and is considered by some to be the national dish of Belgium, which claims to be the country of origin.

french-onion-soup.name: French onion soup
french-onion-soup.about: Deeply caramelised onion soup topped with bread and melted cheese.
steps: Onions are cooked slowly for about an hour until dark and sweet.
Beef broth and wine are added and simmered.
It is topped with toasted bread and Gruyère and grilled until bubbling.

wiki_summary.extract: French onion soup is a soup of onions which are sautéed and then cooked in meat stock or water, usually served gratinéed with croutons or a larger piece of bread covered with cheese floating on top. Onion soups have been known in France since medieval times, but the version now familiar dates from the mid-19th century.

croque-monsieur.name: Croque monsieur
croque-monsieur.about: A grilled ham and cheese sandwich covered in béchamel.
steps: Ham and Gruyère go between slices of bread.
It is topped with béchamel and more cheese.
It is baked or grilled until golden. With a fried egg on top it's a croque madame.

wiki_summary.extract: A croque monsieur is a hot sandwich made with ham and cheese.

coq-au-vin.name: Coq au vin
coq-au-vin.about: Chicken braised in red wine with mushrooms, bacon and onions.
steps: Chicken is browned with bacon.
It is braised slowly in red wine with herbs.
Mushrooms and small onions are added and the sauce is reduced.

wiki_summary.extract:
Coq au vin is a French dish of chicken braised with wine, lardons, mushrooms, and optionally garlic.
A red Burgundy wine is typically used, though many regions of France make variants using local wines, such as coq au vin jaune (Jura), coq au riesling (Alsace), coq au pourpre or coq au violet, and coq au Champagne.

creme-brulee.name: Crème brûlée
creme-brulee.about: Cold vanilla custard under a thin layer of caramelised sugar.
steps: Cream, egg yolks, sugar and vanilla are baked gently into a custard.
It is chilled.
Sugar is sprinkled on top and burned with a torch into a hard caramel shell.
creme-brulee.tip: Tap the top with your spoon to crack it.

wiki_summary.extract: Crème brûlée, also known as burnt cream, Cambridge burnt cream, or Trinity cream, and virtually identical to crema catalana, is a dessert consisting of a rich custard base topped with a layer of hardened caramelized sugar. It is normally served slightly chilled; the heat from the caramelizing process tends to warm the top of the custard, while leaving the center cool. The custard base is generally flavored with vanilla in French cuisine, but can have other flavorings. It is sometimes garnished with fruit.

croissant.name: Croissant
steps: Yeast dough is folded around a block of butter and rolled out many times, building thin layers.
It is cut into triangles and rolled into crescents.
It rises and is baked until the layers puff and crisp.

wiki_summary.extract: A croissant is a Viennoiserie in a crescent shape made from a laminated yeast dough that sits between a bread and a puff pastry.

paella.name: Paella
paella.about: Saffron rice cooked in a wide pan with seafood, chicken or vegetables.
steps: Meat, seafood and vegetables are browned in a wide, shallow pan.
Rice, saffron and stock are added and cooked without stirring.
The bottom forms a crispy crust called socarrat.
paella.tip: Often made for two or more and can take 30–40 minutes.

wiki_summary.extract: Paella is a rice dish originally from the Valencian Community. Paella is regarded as one of the community's identifying symbols. It is one of the best-known dishes in Spanish cuisine.

patatas-bravas.name: Patatas bravas
patatas-bravas.about: Fried potato cubes with spicy tomato sauce and garlic mayonnaise.
steps: Potato cubes are fried until crisp.
A spicy smoked-paprika tomato sauce is made.
The potatoes are topped with the sauce and garlic aioli.

wiki_summary.extract: Patatas bravas, also called patatas a la brava or tortilla, all meaning "spicy potatoes") is a dish native to Spain. It typically consists of white potatoes that have been cut into two-centimeter-wide cubes, then fried in oil and served hot with a spicy "brava" sauce. The brava sauce is primarily sweet or smoked paprika (using high-quality Spanish pimentón de la Vera and olive-oil-based, often thickened with cornstarch. Some regions call for the addition of tomato paste, although there can be many variations.

tortilla-espanola.name: Spanish tortilla
tortilla-espanola.about: A thick omelette of potatoes and onions, served in wedges.
steps: Sliced potatoes and onions are cooked slowly in olive oil until soft.
They are mixed with beaten eggs.
It is cooked in a pan, flipped with a plate, and cooked on the other side.

wiki_summary.extract: A Spanish omelette or Spanish tortilla is an omelette made with eggs and potatoes, often including onions. It is often served at room temperature as a tapa. It is one of the most popular dishes in Spanish cuisine.

gambas-al-ajillo.name: Garlic shrimp
gambas-al-ajillo.about: Shrimp sizzled in olive oil with lots of garlic and chilli.
steps: Garlic and chilli are warmed in plenty of olive oil.
Shrimp are cooked in it for a couple of minutes.
It is served sizzling with bread to soak up the oil.

wiki_summary.extract: Gambas al ajillo —as the dish is known in Spain—is a popular Spanish dish originating in Madrid and is most commonly found in the central and northern regions of the country. The ingredients that make up this dish are peeled shrimp, garlic, and olive oil. It is typically served as a ración (portion) in bars. This dish is a staple of Spanish bar culture.

churros.name: Churros
churros.about: Fried ridged dough sticks rolled in sugar, often with chocolate.
steps: A thick dough is piped through a star-shaped nozzle into hot oil.
It is fried until crisp.
It is rolled in cinnamon sugar and dipped in hot chocolate.

wiki_summary.extract: A churro is a type of fried dough from Spanish and Portuguese cuisine, made with choux pastry dough piped into hot oil with a piping bag and large closed star tip or similar shape. They are also found in Latin American cuisine, Philippine cuisine and in other areas that have received immigration from Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking countries, especially in France and the Southwestern United States.

jerk-chicken.name: Jerk chicken
jerk-chicken.about: Jamaican chicken marinated in a hot, smoky allspice and scotch bonnet paste, grilled.
steps: Chicken is marinated overnight in a paste of scotch bonnet, allspice and herbs.
It is grilled slowly over pimento wood or charcoal.
It is chopped and served with rice and peas and plantain.
