jerk-chicken.tip: Usually hot. Ask for the sauce on the side.

wiki_summary.extract: Jerk is a style of cooking native to Jamaica, in which meat is dry-rubbed or wet-marinated with a hot spice mixture called Jamaican jerk spice.

oxtail.name: Oxtail stew
oxtail.about: Rich, slow-braised oxtail with butter beans in a dark gravy.
steps: Oxtail is seasoned and browned.
It is braised for hours until it falls off the bone.
Butter beans are added and the gravy is thickened.

wiki_summary.extract: Oxtail is the culinary name for the tail of cattle. While the word once meant only the tail of an ox, today it can also refer to the tails of other cattle. An oxtail typically weighs around 3.5 kilograms and is skinned and cut into shorter lengths for sale.

jamaican-patty.name: Jamaican beef patty
jamaican-patty.about: A flaky golden turnover filled with spiced ground beef.
steps: Ground beef is cooked with onion, thyme and pepper.
The filling is folded into turmeric-coloured pastry and sealed.
It is baked until flaky.
jamaican-patty.tip: Ask for it "with coco bread" for a patty sandwich.

wiki_summary.extract: A Jamaican patty is a semicircular pastry that contains various fillings and spices baked inside a flaky shell, often tinted golden yellow with an egg yolk mixture, annatto or turmeric. It is a type of turnover, and is formed by folding the circular dough cutout over the chosen filling, but is savoury and filled with ground meat.

rice-and-peas.name: Rice and peas
rice-and-peas.about: Rice cooked with kidney beans, coconut milk and thyme.
steps: Kidney beans are cooked until soft.
Rice, coconut milk and seasonings are added.
It simmers until the rice absorbs the liquid.

wiki_summary.extract: Rice and peas or peas and rice is a traditional rice dish in some Caribbean and Latin American countries. Kidney beans and other similar varieties are typically used to prepare the dish in the Greater Antilles and coastal Latin America. Sometimes, it is made with pigeon peas, otherwise called gungo peas by Jamaicans. Rice and peas recipes vary throughout the region, with each country having its own way(s) of making them and name(s)—with the two main ingredients being legumes (peas/beans) and rice, combined with herbs, spices and/or coconut milk.

ackee-saltfish.name: Ackee and saltfish
ackee-saltfish.about: Jamaica's national dish of ackee fruit sautéed with salt cod and peppers.
steps: Salt cod is soaked and boiled to remove salt, then flaked.
Onion, peppers and tomato are sautéed.
Ackee (which looks like scrambled egg) and the fish are folded in gently.

wiki_summary.extract: Ackee and saltfish is the Jamaican national dish prepared with sauteed ackee and salted codfish.

empanadas.name: Empanadas
empanadas.about: Baked or fried pastry turnovers with meat, cheese or vegetable filling.
steps: A savoury filling is cooked.
It is wrapped in dough circles and crimped shut.
They are baked or fried until golden.

wiki_summary.extract: An empanada is a type of baked or fried turnover consisting of pastry and filling, common in Spain, Portugal, other Southern European countries, North African countries, West African countries, South Asian countries, Latin American countries, and the Philippines. The name comes from the Spanish empanar, and translates as 'breaded', that is, wrapped or coated in bread. They are made by folding dough over a filling, which may consist of meat, cheese, tomato, corn, or other ingredients, and then cooking the resulting turnover, either by baking or frying.

mofongo.name: Mofongo
mofongo.about: Fried green plantains mashed with garlic and crispy pork.
steps: Green plantains are sliced and fried.
They are mashed in a wooden pestle with garlic and pork cracklings.
It is shaped into a mound and served with broth or a stew of shrimp, chicken or beef.

wiki_summary.extract:
Mofongo is a dish from Puerto Rico 
with plantains as its main ingredient. Plantains are picked green, cut into pieces and typically fried in more modern versions but can be boiled in broth or roasted, then mashed with salt, garlic, pork, broth, and cooking oil in a wooden pilón. Cassava and sweet potato are boiled, then roasted or flash-fried; plantains can also be made in this method or roasted before flash-frying. The goal is to produce a tight ball of mashed plantains that will absorb the attending condiments and have either pork cracklings (chicharrón) or bits of bacon inside. It is traditionally served with fried meat and chicken broth soup. Particular flavors result from variations that include vegetables, chicken, shrimp, beef, or octopus packed inside or around the plantain orb.

pernil.name: Pernil
pernil.about: Slow-roasted pork shoulder with garlic and oregano and crispy skin.
steps: Pork is marinated with garlic, oregano and citrus.
It is roasted slowly for hours.
The skin becomes crackling-crisp (cuerito).

wiki_summary.extract: Pernil is a slow-roasted marinated pork leg or pork shoulder common in Puerto Rico, Dominican Republic, Cuba, Colombia, Venezuela and Ecuador. Pernil is typically accompanied by rice and is commonly shared during Christmas.

arroz-con-pollo.name: Arroz con pollo
arroz-con-pollo.about: Chicken and rice cooked together with sofrito, peppers and olives.
steps: Chicken is browned with sofrito, a base of onion, pepper and garlic.
Rice and broth are added.
It cooks covered until the rice is tender and flavoured by the chicken.

wiki_summary.extract: Arroz con pollo is a traditional dish of Latin America. It typically consists of chicken cooked with rice, onions, saffron, and a plethora of other grains or vegetables. In the Dominican Republic it is alternately called locrio de pollo, and in Saint Martin it is called lokri or locreo.

tostones.name: Tostones
tostones.about: Twice-fried smashed green plantain slices, crispy and salty.
steps: Green plantain slices are fried until soft.
They are smashed flat.
They are fried again until crisp and salted.

wiki_summary.extract: Tostones are twice-fried plantain slices commonly found in Latin American cuisine and Caribbean cuisine.

pupusa.name: Pupusa
pupusa.about: Salvadoran thick corn tortillas stuffed with cheese, beans or pork.
steps: Corn dough is filled with cheese, beans or pork and patted into a disc.
It is cooked on a griddle until browned.
It is served with curtido (pickled cabbage slaw) and tomato salsa.

wiki_summary.extract: A pupusa is a thick griddle cake or flatbread from El Salvador and Honduras made with cornmeal or rice flour stuffed with one or more ingredients including cheese, beans, chicharrón, or squash. It can be served with curtido and tomato sauce and is traditionally eaten by hand. Pupusas have origins in Pre-Columbian Mesoamerica but were first mentioned in 1837 by Guatemalan poet José Batres Montúfar. The pupusa is the national dish of El Salvador. In El Salvador, the pupusa has a national holiday dedicated to it, which is celebrated on the second Sunday of November every year.

cuban-sandwich.name: Cuban sandwich
cuban-sandwich.about: Roast pork, ham, Swiss cheese, pickles and mustard, pressed on Cuban bread.
steps: Bread is filled with roast pork, ham, cheese, pickles and mustard.
It is buttered on the outside.
It is pressed in a hot sandwich press until crisp and melted.

wiki_summary.extract: A Cuban sandwich is a variation of a ham and cheese sandwich that likely originated before the turn of the 20th century in cafes catering to Cuban workers in Tampa or Key West, two early Cuban immigrant communities in Florida, United States, centered on the cigar industry. Later on, Cuban exiles and expatriates brought it to Miami, where it is also very popular. The sandwich is made with ham, roast pork, Swiss cheese, pickles, mustard, and sometimes salami on Cuban bread. Salami is included in Tampa, but is not usually included in South Florida.

arepa.name: Arepa
arepa.about: A thick grilled corn cake split and stuffed with fillings.
steps: Corn dough is shaped into thick discs.
They are grilled or fried until crisp outside.
They are split and stuffed with cheese, beef, beans or avocado.

wiki_summary.extract: An arepa is a type of flatbread made of ground maize dough that may be stuffed with a filling, eaten in northern parts of South America since pre-Columbian times, and notable primarily in the cuisine of Colombia and Venezuela, but also present in Bolivia, Ecuador, and Central America.

ceviche.name: Ceviche
ceviche.about: Raw fish "cooked" in fresh lime juice with chilli and red onion.
steps: Very fresh fish is cut into cubes.
It is soaked in lime juice, which firms the fish, with chilli and salt.
It is served cold with red onion, sweet potato and corn.

wiki_summary.extract: Ceviche, cebiche, sebiche, or seviche is a traditional cold dish consisting of raw fish or shellfish marinated in citrus and seasonings. Different versions of ceviche are part of the culinary cultures of various Latin American countries along the Pacific Ocean where each iteration is considered native, including Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Mexico, Puerto Rico, Nicaragua, Panama, and Peru. Most notably, ceviche is considered the national dish of Peru and is recognized by UNESCO as an expression of Peruvian traditional cuisine and an Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

lomo-saltado.name: Lomo saltado
lomo-saltado.about: A Peruvian stir-fry of beef, tomato and onion with soy, served with fries and rice.
steps: Beef strips are seared in a very hot wok.
Onion, tomato and chilli are tossed in with soy and vinegar.
It is served with fries and rice.

wiki_summary.extract: Lomo saltado is a traditional Peruvian dish, a stir-fry that typically combines marinated strips of sirloin with onions, tomatoes, french fries, and other ingredients, and is typically served with rice. The dish originated as part of the chifa tradition, the Chinese cuisine of Peru, though its popularity has made it part of the mainstream culture.

pollo-a-la-brasa.name: Peruvian rotisserie chicken
pollo-a-la-brasa.about: Spice-marinated chicken roasted on a spit, with green sauce.
steps: Whole chicken is marinated in garlic, spices and soy.
It is roasted on a rotisserie over charcoal.
It is served with fries, salad and creamy green sauce.

wiki_summary.extract: Pollo a la brasa, pollo asado, blackened chicken, or charcoal chicken is a variety of rotisserie chicken associated with the cuisine of Peru.

aji-de-gallina.name: Ají de gallina
aji-de-gallina.about: Shredded chicken in a creamy, mildly spicy yellow pepper sauce.
steps: Chicken is poached and shredded.
A sauce of yellow chilli, bread soaked in milk, nuts and cheese is cooked until creamy.
The chicken is mixed in and served with rice, egg and olives.

wiki_summary.extract:
Ají de gallina is a Peruvian chicken stew. The dish is considered a popular Peruvian comfort food, and the name translates to "chicken chili" or "hen's chili" in English. Ají de gallina is composed of a sofrito base made by sautéing red onion, garlic, and ají amarillo together, and adding shredded poached poultry and stock. The stew is then thickened with bread soaked in milk or evaporated milk, cheese such as parmesan, and ground nuts such as pecans or walnuts. 
Ají amarillo is a mildly spicy pepper native to South America, common in many Peruvian cuisine dishes. Ají de gallina is typically served with boiled potatoes and white rice, and garnished with black olives and hard-boiled egg.

picanha.name: Picanha
picanha.about: Brazilian grilled top sirloin cap with a thick fat layer, sliced off skewers.
steps: The cut is folded onto skewers with the fat outside and rubbed with coarse salt.
It is grilled over charcoal, the fat basting the meat.
It is sliced off the skewer at the table.
picanha.tip: At a churrascaria, flip your card to green to keep the meat coming, red to stop.

wiki_summary.extract: Picanha is a cut of beef also known as the rump cap (UK), top sirloin cap (US), or coulotte steak (US). It consists of the terminal, triangular part of the biceps femoris muscle in the rump, together with its fat cap. It became popular first in Brazil and later in Portugal. It is now popular across Latin America in churrascarias and rodízio restaurants.

feijoada.name: Feijoada
feijoada.about: Brazil's black bean stew with pork and sausage.
steps: Black beans are simmered with smoked and salted pork.
It cooks for hours into a thick, dark stew.
It is served with rice, greens, farofa and orange slices.

wiki_summary.extract: Feijoada is the name for varieties of bean stew with beef or pork prepared in the Portuguese-speaking world.

pao-de-queijo.name: Pão de queijo
steps: Tapioca flour is mixed with hot milk and oil.
Egg and cheese are beaten in.
Small balls are baked until puffed, crisp outside and chewy inside.

wiki_summary.extract: Pão de queijo or Brazilian cheese bread is a small, baked cheese roll or cheese ball, a popular snack and breakfast food in Brazil. It is a traditional Brazilian recipe, originating in the state of Minas Gerais.

lobster-roll.name: Lobster roll
lobster-roll.about: Chunks of lobster in a buttered, toasted hot dog bun.
steps: Lobster is boiled and the meat is picked out.
It is dressed with mayonnaise (Maine style) or warm butter (Connecticut style).
It is piled into a toasted, buttered bun.

wiki_summary.extract: A lobster roll is a North American dish comprising lobster meat served on a grilled hot dog–style bun, commonly credited to have been invented in Milford, Connecticut. The filling may also contain butter, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, with variants made in some parts of New England replacing the butter with mayonnaise. Other versions may contain diced celery or scallion. Potato chips or French fries are typical side dishes.

clam-chowder.name: Clam chowder
clam-chowder.about: A thick, creamy soup of clams, potatoes and bacon.
steps: Bacon and onion are cooked.
Potatoes, clam juice and cream are added and simmered.
Chopped clams are stirred in at the end. Manhattan-style is tomato-based instead of creamy.

wiki_summary.extract: Clam chowder is any of several chowder soups in American cuisine containing clams. In addition to clams, common ingredients include diced potatoes, salt pork, and onions. It is believed that clams were used in chowder because of the relative ease of harvesting them. Clam chowder is usually served with saltine crackers or small, hexagonal oyster crackers.

fish-and-chips.name: Fish and chips
fish-and-chips.about: Battered fried white fish with thick fries.
steps: Fish fillets are dipped in a beer batter.
They are deep-fried until crisp and golden.
They are served with thick fries, tartar sauce, lemon and vinegar.

wiki_summary.extract: Fish and chips is a hot dish consisting of battered and fried fish served with chips. Often considered the national dish of the United Kingdom, fish and chips originated in England in the 19th century. Today, the dish is a common takeaway food in numerous other countries, particularly English-speaking and Commonwealth nations.

grilled-salmon.name: Grilled salmon
grilled-salmon.about: A salmon fillet grilled with crisp skin, with vegetables.
steps: Salmon is seasoned with salt, pepper and oil.
It is grilled or seared skin-side down until crisp.
It is finished with lemon and herbs and served with vegetables.

wiki_summary.extract: Salmon is a common food fish classified as an oily fish with a rich content of protein and omega-3 fatty acids. Norway is a major producer of farmed and wild salmon, accounting for more than 50% of global salmon production. Farmed and wild salmon differ only slightly in terms of food quality and safety, with farmed salmon having lower content of environmental contaminants, and wild salmon having higher content of omega-3 fatty acids.

oysters.name: Raw oysters
oysters.about: Fresh oysters on ice, opened to order and eaten raw.
steps: Live oysters are opened (shucked) right before serving.
They are served on ice in the half-shell.
You add lemon or mignonette and slurp them from the shell.
oysters.tip: Often sold by the piece; many bars have a cheaper "happy hour" oyster deal.

wiki_summary.extract: Oyster is the common name for a number of different families of salt-water bivalve molluscs that live in marine or brackish habitats. In some species, the valves are highly calcified, and many are somewhat irregular in shape. Many oysters are in the superfamily Ostreoidea.

ribeye.name: Ribeye steak
ribeye.about: A rich, well-marbled steak grilled or broiled to your chosen doneness.
steps: The steak is seasoned with salt and pepper.
It is seared at very high heat, often under a broiler.
It is rested and served, often with butter melting on top.
ribeye.tip: Rare is red and cool inside, medium-rare warm red, medium pink, well done grey.

wiki_summary.extract: The rib eye or ribeye is a boneless rib steak from the rib section of cattle, though occasionally other animals will have cuts described as ribeye, such as deer. The cut is popular for cuisines around the world, with French language butchering describing a similar entrecôte steak, and Latin American cusines having similar concepts, like ojo de bife in Argentina and lomo vetado in Chile.

creamed-spinach.name: Creamed spinach
creamed-spinach.about: Spinach cooked in a rich cream sauce, a steakhouse side.
steps: Spinach is wilted and squeezed dry.
A sauce of butter, cream and garlic is made.
The spinach is folded in with parmesan and nutmeg.

wiki_summary.extract: Creamed spinach is a dish consisting of a spinach coated in a creamy sauce, which can be used as side dish or topping. It is a common side dish at steakhouses but can be found in everything from frozen TV dinners, fast casual, to gourmet restaurants and North American and European home dishes.

wedge-salad.name: Wedge salad
wedge-salad.about: A crisp wedge of iceberg lettuce with blue cheese dressing and bacon.
steps: A head of iceberg lettuce is cut into quarters.
Each wedge is covered in blue cheese dressing.
It is topped with bacon, tomato and onion.

wiki_summary.extract: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.

brisket.name: Brisket
brisket.about: Beef smoked low and slow for 12+ hours until tender, with a dark peppery crust.
steps: Brisket is rubbed with salt and coarse pepper.
It is smoked over wood at low heat for 12 hours or more.
It is rested and sliced; the outer crust is called bark.
brisket.tip: BBQ is often sold by weight. Half a pound is a good portion.

wiki_summary.extract: Brisket is a primal cut of meat from the breast or lower chest of beef or veal. The beef brisket is one of the nine beef primal cuts, though the definition of the cut differs internationally. The brisket muscles include the superficial and deep pectorals. As cattle do not have collar bones, these muscles support about 60% of the body weight of standing or moving cattle. This requires a significant amount of connective tissue, so the resulting meat must be cooked correctly to tenderise it. The cut overlies the sternum, ribs, and connecting costal cartilages.

pulled-pork.name: Pulled pork
pulled-pork.about: Smoked pork shoulder pulled into shreds and sauced.
steps: Pork shoulder is rubbed with spices.
It is smoked slowly until very tender.
It is pulled apart and served with sauce, often in a bun with slaw.

wiki_summary.extract: Pulled pork is an American barbecue dish, more specifically a dish of the Southern United States, based on shredded barbecued pork shoulder. It is typically slow-smoked over wood ; indoor variations use a slow cooker. The meat is then shredded manually and mixed with a sauce. It may be served on bread as a sandwich, or eaten on its own.

ribs.name: Barbecue ribs
ribs.about: Pork ribs smoked until tender and glazed with sauce.
steps: Ribs are coated in a spice rub.
They are smoked for several hours.
They are brushed with sauce and finished over heat.

wiki_summary.extract: Pork ribs are a cut of pork popular in Western and Asian cuisines. The rib cage of a domestic pig, meat and bones together, is cut into usable pieces, prepared by smoking, grilling, or baking – usually with a sauce, often barbecue – and then served.

cornbread.name: Cornbread
cornbread.about: A slightly sweet, crumbly bread made from cornmeal.
steps: Cornmeal, flour and buttermilk are mixed.
The batter is poured into a hot buttered pan.
It is baked until golden.

wiki_summary.extract: Cornbread is a quick bread made with cornmeal, popular in the cuisine of the Southern United States, with origins in Native American cuisine. It is an example of batter bread. Dumplings and pancakes made with finely ground cornmeal are staple foods of the Hopi people in Arizona. The Hidatsa people of the Upper Midwest call baked cornbread naktsi, while the Choctaw people of the Southeast call it bvnaha. The Cherokee and Seneca tribes enrich the basic batter, adding chestnuts, sunflower seeds, apples, or berries, and sometimes combine it with beans or potatoes. Modern versions of cornbread are usually leavened by baking powder.

coleslaw.name: Coleslaw
coleslaw.about: Shredded cabbage salad in a creamy or vinegar dressing.
steps: Cabbage and carrot are finely shredded.
They are mixed with a creamy or tangy dressing.
It is chilled before serving.

wiki_summary.extract: Coleslaw or cole slaw, also widely known within North America simply as slaw, is a side dish consisting primarily of finely shredded raw cabbage with a salad dressing or condiment, commonly either vinaigrette or mayonnaise. This dish originated in the Netherlands in the 18th century. Coleslaw prepared with vinaigrette may benefit from the long lifespan granted by pickling.

pastrami-on-rye.name: Pastrami on rye
pastrami-on-rye.about: A towering New York deli sandwich of hot sliced pastrami with mustard.
steps: Beef brisket is brined, coated in pepper and coriander, smoked and steamed into pastrami.
It is sliced hot and piled high on rye bread.
It is served with mustard and a pickle.
pastrami-on-rye.tip: Deli sandwiches are huge; sharing one is normal.

wiki_summary.extract: Pastrami on rye is a sandwich comprising sliced pastrami on rye bread, often served with mustard and Kosher dill pickles. It was popularized in the Jewish delicatessens of New York City and has been described as New York's "signature sandwich". It was created in 1888 by the Lithuanian immigrant Sussman Volk, who served it at his deli on Delancey Street in Manhattan.

reuben.name: Reuben sandwich
reuben.about: Corned beef, Swiss cheese, sauerkraut and Russian dressing on grilled rye.
steps: Corned beef, cheese and sauerkraut are layered on rye with dressing.
The bread is buttered.
It is grilled until crisp and the cheese melts.

wiki_summary.extract: The Reuben sandwich is an American grilled sandwich comprising corned beef, Swiss cheese, sauerkraut, and Russian dressing or Thousand Island dressing, grilled between slices of rye bread. The sandwich is traditionally grilled or toasted until the bread is crisp and the cheese has melted.

bacon-egg-cheese.name: Bacon, egg and cheese
bacon-egg-cheese.about: New York's classic breakfast sandwich, on a roll or bagel.
steps: Eggs are fried or scrambled on the griddle.
Bacon and American cheese are added so the cheese melts.
It goes on a buttered roll, often with "salt, pepper, ketchup".
bacon-egg-cheese.tip: Order it at any deli or bodega as "a BEC". "SPK" means salt, pepper, ketchup.

wiki_summary.extract: A bacon, egg, and cheese sandwich (BEC), also known as a baconeggandcheese, is a breakfast sandwich made with bacon, eggs, cheese and bread. It is popular in the United States and Canada.

blt.name: BLT
blt.about: A sandwich of bacon, lettuce and tomato with mayonnaise on toast.
steps: Bacon is cooked until crisp.
Bread is toasted and spread with mayonnaise.
It is layered with bacon, lettuce and tomato.

wiki_summary.extract: A BLT is a type of sandwich, named for the initials of its primary ingredients, bacon, lettuce, and tomato. It can be made with varying recipes according to personal preference. Simple variants include using different types of lettuce or tomatoes, toasting or not, or adding mayonnaise. More pronounced variants include using turkey bacon or tofu in place of regular bacon, removing the lettuce entirely, or adding other ingredients such as a fried egg, avocado (BLAT), or sprouts.

bagel-cream-cheese.name: Bagel with cream cheese
bagel-cream-cheese.about: A chewy boiled-and-baked bagel spread with cream cheese.
steps: Bagel dough is shaped into rings and boiled briefly, which makes them chewy.
They are baked until shiny and golden.
The bagel is split, often toasted, and spread with cream cheese.
bagel-cream-cheese.tip: Order "everything bagel with scallion cream cheese" for a classic.

wiki_summary.extract: A bagel is a bread roll originating in the Jewish communities of Poland. Bagels are traditionally made from yeasted wheat dough that is shaped by hand into a torus or ring, briefly boiled in water, and then baked. The result is a dense, chewy, doughy interior with a browned and sometimes crisp exterior.

bagel-lox.name: Bagel with lox
bagel-lox.about: A bagel with cream cheese, thin smoked salmon, capers and onion.
steps: Salmon is cured in salt (lox) or cold-smoked (nova).
It is sliced very thin.
It is layered on a bagel with cream cheese, onion, capers and tomato.

wiki_summary.extract: Lox is a fillet of brined salmon, which may be smoked. Lox is frequently served on a bagel with cream cheese, and often garnished with tomato, onion, cucumber, and capers.

latte.name: Latte
latte.about: Espresso with a lot of steamed milk and a thin layer of foam.
steps: A shot of espresso is pulled.
Milk is steamed until silky.
The milk is poured into the espresso, often with a design on top.
latte.tip: Oat, almond and soy milk are usually available for a small extra charge.

wiki_summary.extract: Latte or caffè latte, also known as caffellatte, caffelatte, or rarely caffè e latte, is a coffee drink of Italian origin made with espresso coffee and steamed milk, traditionally served in a glass.

cappuccino.name: Cappuccino
cappuccino.about: Espresso with equal parts steamed milk and thick foam.
steps: A shot of espresso is pulled.
Milk is steamed with more air to make thick foam.
It is poured so the cup is about one third foam.

wiki_summary.extract: Cappuccino is an espresso-based coffee drink traditionally prepared with steamed milk, including a layer of milk foam.

cold-brew.name: Cold brew
cold-brew.about: Coffee steeped in cold water for many hours, smooth and strong, served over ice.
steps: Coarse coffee grounds are soaked in cold water for 12 to 24 hours.
It is strained into a concentrate.
It is served over ice, black or with milk.

wiki_summary.extract: Cold brew coffee, also called cold water extraction or cold pressing, is a type of coffee prepared by the process of steeping coffee grounds in water at cool temperatures for an extended period. Coarse-ground beans are soaked in water for 12 to 24 hours.

matcha-latte.name: Matcha latte
matcha-latte.about: Powdered Japanese green tea whisked with steamed milk.
steps: Matcha powder is whisked with a little hot water until frothy.
Milk is steamed.
They are combined, hot or over ice.

wiki_summary.extract: Matcha is a finely ground powder of green tea specially processed from shade-grown tea leaves. Shade growing gives matcha its characteristic bright green color and strong umami flavor. Matcha is typically consumed suspended in hot water.

bubble-tea.name: Bubble tea
bubble-tea.about: Sweet milk tea with chewy tapioca pearls, drunk through a wide straw.
steps: Tapioca pearls are boiled until chewy and soaked in syrup.
Tea is brewed and mixed with milk and sugar.
It is shaken with ice and poured over the pearls.
bubble-tea.tip: You can usually choose sweetness (like 50%) and ice level.

wiki_summary.extract: Bubble tea is a tea-based drink most often containing chewy tapioca pearls, milk, and flavoring. It originated in Taiwan in the 1980s and spread to other countries where there is a large East Asian diaspora population.

donut.name: Donut
donut.about: A sweet fried ring or round of dough, glazed or filled.
steps: A soft yeast dough rises and is cut into rings.
They are fried until puffed and golden.
They are dipped in glaze, icing or sugar, or filled with jam or cream.

wiki_summary.extract: A doughnut or donut is a type of fried or baked good made from leavened dough. It is popular in many countries and is prepared in various forms as a sweet snack that can be homemade or purchased in bakeries, supermarkets, food stalls, and franchised specialty vendors.

cheesecake.name: New York cheesecake
cheesecake.about: A dense, rich and creamy baked cheesecake on a graham cracker crust.
steps: Crushed graham crackers and butter are pressed into a pan.
Cream cheese, sugar, eggs and sour cream are beaten smooth and poured on top.
It is baked slowly and chilled overnight.

wiki_summary.extract: Cheesecake is a dessert made with a soft fresh cheese, and sugar, with either eggs or cream depending if it is to be baked or not. It may have a crust or base made from crushed cookies, digestive biscuits, graham crackers, pastry, or sometimes sponge cake. Cheesecake is known for its rich, creamy flavor and smooth texture. It may be baked or unbaked and is usually served chilled.

gelato.name: Gelato
gelato.about: Dense Italian ice cream with intense flavour.
steps: A base of milk and sugar is flavoured.
It is churned slowly so less air is whipped in than in ice cream.
It is served slightly warmer than ice cream, so it's softer.

wiki_summary.extract: Gelato refers to a specific type of ice cream of Italian origin. In Italian, gelato is the common word for all types of ice cream. Artisanal gelato in Italy generally contains 6–9% butterfat, which is lower than other styles of frozen dessert. Gelato typically contains 20–35% air, and more flavoring than other types of frozen desserts, giving it an intense flavor with creamy, smooth texture, density and richness that distinguishes it from other ice creams.

buddha-bowl.name: Grain bowl
buddha-bowl.about: A bowl of grains, roasted vegetables, greens, protein and a sauce.
steps: A base of grains is cooked.
Vegetables and protein are roasted or prepared separately.
Everything is arranged in a bowl and dressed.

wiki_summary.extract: A Buddha bowl is a vegetarian meal, served in a single bowl or on a high-rimmed plate, which consists of small portions of several foods, served cold. These may include whole grains such as quinoa or brown rice, plant proteins such as chickpeas or tofu, and vegetables. The portions are not mixed on the plate nor in the bowl but arranged "artfully". Buddha bowls have been compared to nourish bowls and to poké bowls.

veggie-burger.name: Veggie burger
veggie-burger.about: A burger with a plant-based patty.
steps: A patty is made from beans, grains and vegetables, or a meat-like plant protein.
It is grilled or griddled.
It is served in a bun with toppings.
veggie-burger.tip: Check the bun and cheese if you're vegan.

wiki_summary.extract: A veggie burger or meatless burger is a hamburger made with a patty that does not contain meat, or the patty of such a hamburger. The patty may be made from ingredients like beans, nuts, grains, seeds, or fungi such as mushrooms or mycoprotein.

schnitzel.name: Schnitzel
schnitzel.about: A thin breaded and fried cutlet of pork or veal.
steps: Meat is pounded very thin.
It is coated in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
It is fried until golden and served with lemon and potato salad.

wiki_summary.extract: Schnitzel is a thin slice of meat. The meat is usually thinned by pounding with a meat tenderizer. Most commonly, the meat is breaded before frying. Breaded schnitzel is popular in many countries and is made using veal, pork, chicken, mutton, beef, or turkey. Schnitzel originated as Wiener schnitzel and is very similar to other breaded meat dishes.

bratwurst.name: Bratwurst
bratwurst.about: A grilled German pork sausage with mustard and sauerkraut.
steps: Fresh pork sausage is grilled or pan-fried.
It is served in a roll or on a plate.
It comes with mustard and sauerkraut.

wiki_summary.extract: Bratwurst is a type of German sausage made from pork or, less commonly, beef, veal, or any combination of beef, veal, and pork. The name is derived from the Old High German Brätwurst, from brät-, finely chopped meat, and Wurst, sausage, although in modern German it is often associated with the verb braten, to pan fry or roast.

pretzel.name: Soft pretzel
pretzel.about: A chewy knotted bread with a dark, salty crust.
steps: Dough is rolled into ropes and twisted into a knot.
It is dipped in an alkaline bath, which gives the dark crust.
It is salted and baked.

wiki_summary.extract: A pretzel is a type of baked pastry made from dough that is commonly shaped into a knot. The traditional pretzel shape is a distinctive symmetrical form, with the ends of a long strip of dough intertwined and then twisted back onto itself in a particular way. Today, pretzels come in various shapes, textures, and colors, but the original soft pretzel remains one of the most common pretzel types.

pierogi.name: Pierogi
pierogi.about: Boiled dumplings filled with potato and cheese, meat or cabbage.
steps: Dough circles are filled and pinched closed.
They are boiled, then often pan-fried in butter.
They are served with fried onions and sour cream.

wiki_summary.extract: Pierogi are filled dumplings made by wrapping unleavened dough around a filling and cooking in boiling water. They are occasionally flavored with a savory or sweet garnish. Typical fillings include potato and tvorog cheese, sauerkraut, ground meat, mushrooms, fruits, or berries. Savory pierogi are often served with a topping of sour cream, fried onions, or both.

borscht.name: Borscht
borscht.about: A sweet-sour beet soup, served with sour cream.
steps: Beets and vegetables are simmered in broth.
It is seasoned with vinegar or lemon for tang.
It is served with sour cream and dill.

wiki_summary.extract: Borscht is a sour soup, made with meat stock, vegetables and seasonings, common in Eastern Europe, Central Europe and Northern Asia. In English, the word borscht, borrowed via Yiddish, is most often associated with the variant of the soup originating in Ukraine, made with red beetroots as one of the main ingredients, which give the dish its distinctive red color. The same name, however, is also used for a wide selection of sour-tasting soups without beetroots, such as sorrel-based green borscht, rye-based white borscht, and cabbage borscht.

khachapuri.name: Khachapuri
khachapuri.about: Georgian boat-shaped cheese bread with an egg and butter in the middle.
steps: Dough is shaped into a boat and filled with cheese.
It is baked until golden.
An egg yolk and butter are added at the end; you stir them into the cheese and dip the crust.

wiki_summary.extract: Khachapuri is a Georgian dish of cheese-filled bread. The bread is leavened and allowed to rise, molded into various shapes, and then filled in the center with a mixture of cheese, and sometimes eggs or other ingredients.
